sec05-R05-card.expected_back: The action table assigns a mandatory six-month suspension at sixteen calculated points.

sec05-R06-card.front: What mandatory suspension length applies at eighteen calculated points?
sec05-R06-card.expected_back: The action table assigns a mandatory eight-month suspension at eighteen calculated points.

sec05-R07-card.front: How many months of mandatory suspension apply when calculated points reach twenty?
sec05-R07-card.expected_back: The action table assigns a mandatory ten-month suspension at twenty calculated points.

sec05-R08-card.front: What course requirement applies to reinstate after a fourteen-, sixteen-, eighteen-, or twenty-point suspension?
sec05-R08-card.expected_back: Reinstatement following the listed fourteen-, sixteen-, eighteen- or twenty-point suspension requires completion of a behavior-modification or attitudinal-driving course within the preceding two years.

sec05-R09-card.front: What mandatory suspension period does Delaware assign at twenty-two calculated points?
sec05-R09-card.expected_back: The action table assigns a mandatory twelve-month suspension at twenty-two calculated points.

sec05-R10-card.front: Within what lookback window must a behavior or attitudinal course be completed to reinstate after twenty-two points?
sec05-R10-card.expected_back: Reinstatement after the twenty-two-point suspension requires a behavior-modification or attitudinal-driving course completed within the preceding two years.

sec05-R11-card.front: Under what conditions does a Class D driver avoid points on a first one-to-fourteen-mph speeding ticket in three years?
sec05-R11-card.expected_back: For a Class D driver’s first speeding violation within three years at one through fourteen miles per hour above the limit, points are avoided only if payment is through the Voluntary Assessment Center or Alderman’s Court recorded as guilty mail-in, or through online payment.

sec05-R12-card.front: What administrative step follows a conviction for going twenty to twenty-four over the speed limit?
sec05-R12-card.expected_back: A speeding conviction for twenty through twenty-four miles per hour above the posted limit leads to an advisory letter.

sec05-R13-card.front: How is suspension length calculated starting at twenty-five miles per hour above the posted speed limit?
sec05-R13-card.expected_back: A conviction for driving twenty-five miles per hour above the limit brings an initial one-month suspension, with another month added for each further five miles per hour above that threshold.

sec05-R14-card.front: Which high-speed conviction bracket lets a driver choose the behavior or attitudinal course instead of suspension?
sec05-R14-card.expected_back: A driver convicted of speeding twenty-five through twenty-nine miles per hour above the limit may choose the behavior-modification or attitudinal-driving course instead of suspension.

sec05-R15-card.front: What happens to suspension and reinstatement once speeding reaches thirty miles per hour or more above the limit?
sec05-R15-card.expected_back: At thirty miles per hour or more above the posted limit, suspension is mandatory and reinstatement requires the behavior-modification or attitudinal-driving course within the preceding two years.

sec05-R16-card.front: What penalty applies for driving at least fifty over the limit or hitting one hundred miles per hour on a highway?
sec05-R16-card.expected_back: A conviction for driving at least fifty miles per hour above the limit or driving one hundred miles per hour on a highway brings a one-year suspension and requires the approved course within the preceding two years for reinstatement.

sec05-R17-card.front: When may the DMV grant an occupational license during a Problem Driver Program suspension?
sec05-R17-card.expected_back: The DMV may issue an occupational license for extreme hardship during a Problem Driver Program suspension unless other Title twenty-one convictions also cause suspension or revocation.

sec05-R18-card.front: Which two prior-record conditions disqualify a driver from receiving an occupational license?
sec05-R18-card.expected_back: An occupational license is unavailable after two prior suspensions under the policy within three years or an occupational license issued within the previous twelve months.

sec05-R19-card.front: During which part of a suspension will the DMV never issue an occupational license?
sec05-R19-card.expected_back: An occupational license is not issued during the first month of suspension.

sec05-R20-card.front: What happens to occupational-license eligibility when calculated points reach fifteen or more within twenty-four months?
sec05-R20-card.expected_back: When calculated points reach at least fifteen within twenty-four months, an occupational license is withheld until the calculated total falls below fifteen.

sec05-R21-card.front: What two penalties apply if you are convicted of violating occupational-license restrictions?
sec05-R21-card.expected_back: A conviction for violating occupational-license restrictions adds an equal suspension period and requires surrender of the occupational license.

sec05-R22-card.front: How much extra withdrawal time is added for driving during a suspension or revocation?
sec05-R22-card.expected_back: A conviction for driving during suspension or revocation adds an equal withdrawal period, limited to one year.

sec05-R23-card.front: Is any driving authority permitted during the remaining withdrawal or extension after driving suspended, and what must happen to prior authority?
sec05-R23-card.expected_back: No driving authority is allowed during the remainder of the original suspension or revocation or during its extension, and previously issued authority must be surrendered.

sec05-R24-card.front: How many listed offenses during one continuous episode establish aggressive driving in Delaware?
sec05-R24-card.expected_back: A continuous episode producing convictions for at least three aggressive-driving traffic offenses, such as speeding, unsafe lane changes or following too closely, meets the handbook’s aggressive-driving definition.

sec05-R25-card.front: What fine range applies to a first aggressive-driving offense in Delaware?
sec05-R25-card.expected_back: The first aggressive-driving offense carries a fine from one hundred dollars to three hundred dollars.

sec05-R26-card.front: Within how many days must someone convicted of aggressive driving finish the behavior or attitudinal course?
sec05-R26-card.expected_back: An aggressive-driving conviction requires completion of the behavior-modification or attitudinal-driving course within ninety days.

sec05-R27-card.front: What happens if a driver fails to attend the required course after an aggressive-driving conviction?
sec05-R27-card.expected_back: Failure to attend the required aggressive-driving course results in suspension of driving privileges.

sec05-R28-card.front: How long is Delaware's approved behavior-modification course, and where in the state is it offered?
sec05-R28-card.expected_back: The approved behavior-modification or attitudinal-driving course lasts at least eight hours and is offered in all three Delaware counties.

sec05-R29-card.front: How much does the behavior-modification course cost, and who receives that payment?
sec05-R29-card.expected_back: The handbook states that the behavior-modification course costs one hundred dollars, payable to the course provider.

sec05-R30-card.front: How quickly does the course provider transmit electronic completion notice to the DMV?
sec05-R30-card.expected_back: After course completion, the provider sends electronic completion notice to the DMV within forty-eight hours.

sec05-R31-card.front: How many points of administrative credit may the DMV grant for completing an approved defensive-driving course?
sec05-R31-card.expected_back: The DMV may treat successful completion of an approved defensive-driving course as a three-point credit for calculating administrative driver penalties.

sec05-R32-card.front: Does defensive-driving credit erase existing DMV points or lower totals seen for employment or insurance review?
sec05-R32-card.expected_back: The defensive-driving credit is used only for administrative action on future violations and does not erase existing DMV points or reduce the full-value total used for employment or insurance review.

sec05-R33-card.front: For how many years does an approved defensive-driving course remain valid after completion?
sec05-R33-card.expected_back: An approved defensive-driving course remains valid for three years after completion.

sec05-R34-card.front: How does consuming even a small amount of alcohol affect crash risk compared with drinking none?
sec05-R34-card.expected_back: Even a small amount of alcohol increases crash risk compared with drinking no alcohol.

sec07-F01-card.front: What registration status is required for vehicles operated on Delaware highways?
sec07-F01-card.expected_back: Vehicles used on Delaware highways must be registered.

sec07-F02-card.front: How many days do new Delaware residents have after moving in to title and register their vehicles?
sec07-F02-card.expected_back: New Delaware residents have sixty days after moving to title and register their vehicles.

sec07-F03-card.front: How many headlights of what color, beam type, and placement does a Delaware-registered automobile need?
sec07-F03-card.expected_back: A Delaware-registered automobile needs at least two white multibeam headlights, with one on either front side.

sec07-F04-card.front: At least how many feet ahead must high beams illuminate people and vehicles?
sec07-F04-card.expected_back: High beams must illuminate people and vehicles at a distance of at least three hundred fifty feet.

sec07-F05-card.front: How far ahead must low beams illuminate people, and where must their light avoid shining?
sec07-F05-card.expected_back: Low beams must illuminate people at least one hundred feet ahead without shining into an approaching driver’s eyes.

sec07-F06-card.front: What lighting rule applies whenever windshield wipers are running due to bad weather?
sec07-F06-card.expected_back: Headlights must operate while the wipers are used because of bad weather.

sec07-F07-card.front: How many original-design rear taillights of what color and visibility distance are required?
sec07-F07-card.expected_back: The rear must have at least two red taillights of the original design, visible at five hundred feet.

sec07-F08-card.front: What color options and visibility distance apply to the required front parking light?
sec07-F08-card.expected_back: At least one front parking light must be white or amber and visible at five hundred feet.

sec07-F09-card.front: What color and visibility distance apply to the rear parking light, and can a taillight fulfill it?
sec07-F09-card.expected_back: At least one rear parking light must be red and visible at five hundred feet; a taillight can serve this purpose.

sec07-F10-card.front: What color must the registration-plate light be, and from how far must the tag number be readable?
sec07-F10-card.expected_back: The registration-plate light must be white and make the number readable at fifty feet.

sec07-F11-card.front: Where must a registration-plate light never cast its beam?
sec07-F11-card.expected_back: The plate light must not cast light toward vehicles proceeding in the same direction.

sec07-F12-card.front: Which colors are permitted for an original-design rear stop light in Delaware?
sec07-F12-card.expected_back: A rear stop light of the original design must be amber, red, or a shade between them.

sec07-F13-card.front: What activates a stop light, and how far away must it be visible in normal sunlight?
sec07-F13-card.expected_back: A stop light must illuminate with brake-pedal use and remain visible at least one hundred feet away in normal sunlight.

sec07-F14-card.front: If a vehicle is equipped with two stop lights, does just one working lamp satisfy Delaware law?
sec07-F14-card.expected_back: When a vehicle has two stop lights, both must operate.

sec07-F15-card.front: What front and rear turn-signal setup is required on vehicles manufactured after nineteen fifty-three?
sec07-F15-card.expected_back: Vehicles made after nineteen fifty-three need two front and two rear turn signals.

sec07-F16-card.front: What color range is legal for front turn signals in Delaware?
sec07-F16-card.expected_back: Front turn-signal colors may range from white through amber.

sec07-F17-card.front: What color range is legal for rear turn signals in Delaware?
sec07-F17-card.expected_back: Rear turn-signal colors may range from amber through red.

sec07-F18-card.front: At what minimum distance must front and rear turn signals be visible in normal sunlight?
sec07-F18-card.expected_back: Both turn-signal sets must be visible at one hundred feet or more in normal sunlight.

sec07-F19-card.front: What rule applies if a vehicle built in nineteen fifty-three or earlier has turn signals installed?
sec07-F19-card.expected_back: Turn signals fitted to vehicles made in nineteen fifty-three or earlier must function.

sec07-F20-card.front: What rear reflector equipment is required on passenger vehicles built after nineteen fifty-three?
sec07-F20-card.expected_back: Passenger vehicles made after nineteen fifty-three need two red rear reflectors.

sec07-F21-card.front: How many reflectors and what color layout are required on vehicles built after nineteen seventy-seven?
sec07-F21-card.expected_back: Vehicles made after nineteen seventy-seven need at least six reflectors: amber at each front side, red at each rear side, and two red at the rear.

sec07-F22-card.front: What minimum surface area and visibility distance must vehicle reflectors meet?
sec07-F22-card.expected_back: Reflectors require four square inches of reflecting area and visibility at five hundred feet.

sec07-F23-card.front: Must vehicle reflectors be separate pieces, or can they be built into lamp lenses?
sec07-F23-card.expected_back: Reflectors can be built into lamp lenses.

sec07-F24-card.front: What side-marker lamps are required on passenger vehicles manufactured since nineteen seventy-two?
sec07-F24-card.expected_back: Passenger vehicles made since nineteen seventy-two need side markers: two amber toward the front sides and two red toward the rear sides.

sec07-F25-card.front: What luminous lens area and visibility distance must side-marker lamps provide?
sec07-F25-card.expected_back: Side-marker lamps require four square inches of luminous lens area and visibility at five hundred feet.

sec07-F26-card.front: How must vehicle brakes apply across the sides of the car, and what standards must they meet?
sec07-F26-card.expected_back: Vehicle brakes must act evenly on every side and satisfy federal braking standards.

sec07-F27-card.front: Within how many feet must the parking or emergency brake stop a vehicle from twenty miles per hour?
sec07-F27-card.expected_back: The parking or emergency brake must halt the vehicle from twenty miles per hour within fifty-four feet.

sec07-F28-card.front: Which vehicle windows must be made of automotive safety glass?
sec07-F28-card.expected_back: The windshield and all side and rear windows must use automotive safety glass.

sec07-F29-card.front: Which stickers or signs are permitted on vehicle windows in Delaware?
sec07-F29-card.expected_back: Window stickers and signs are limited to legally required certificates or DMV-approved items.

sec07-F30-card.front: What must windshield wipers be capable of clearing from the glass?
sec07-F30-card.expected_back: Windshield wipers must clear rain, snow and other moisture.

sec07-F31-card.front: What view must a vehicle's rear-view mirror provide to the driver?
sec07-F31-card.expected_back: A rear-view mirror must let the driver see vehicles moving in the same direction.

sec07-F32-card.front: What mirror equipment is required whenever cargo or design obstructs the interior mirror's view?
sec07-F32-card.expected_back: If the interior mirror’s rearward view is obstructed, outside mirrors are required on both sides.

sec07-F33-card.front: What muffler equipment and operating state does every Delaware motor vehicle require?
sec07-F33-card.expected_back: Every vehicle needs a functioning muffler kept in continuous operation.

sec07-F34-card.front: What noise benchmark applies to vehicles, and how does Delaware treat excessive or loud noise?
sec07-F34-card.expected_back: Vehicle noise must meet federal standards, and excessive or loud noise is prohibited.

sec07-F35-card.front: From at least how many feet away must a vehicle's horn be audible under normal conditions?
sec07-F35-card.expected_back: The horn must be audible at least two hundred feet away under normal conditions.

sec07-F36-card.front: Which passenger cars require safety belts for every front-seat occupant?
sec07-F36-card.expected_back: Passenger cars made after January one, nineteen sixty-eight need belts for every front-seat occupant.

sec07-F37-card.front: From what manufacture cutoff do trucks, buses, and multipassenger vehicles require belts for every front-seat occupant?
sec07-F37-card.expected_back: Trucks, buses and multipassenger vehicles made after July one, nineteen seventy-one need belts for every front-seat occupant.

sec07-F38-card.front: How many spotlights may a vehicle carry, and where must their intense beams never point?
sec07-F38-card.expected_back: A vehicle may carry two spotlights, but their intense beams must not aim left or farther than one hundred feet ahead.

sec07-F39-card.front: How many front fog lamps of what colors and mounting height may a vehicle carry?
sec07-F39-card.expected_back: A vehicle may carry two white or yellow front fog lamps mounted twelve to thirty inches above ground.

sec07-F40-card.front: How much must a fog-lamp beam drop over its first twenty-five feet?
sec07-F40-card.expected_back: A fog-lamp beam must fall at least four inches over its first twenty-five feet.

sec07-F41-card.front: What color range is permitted for rear backing lamps?
sec07-F41-card.expected_back: Rear backing lamps may use shades ranging from white to amber.

sec07-F42-card.front: Which vehicles may display colored lamps beyond standard factory lights, markers, and turn signals?
sec07-F42-card.expected_back: Colored lighting beyond factory equipment, marker lamps and turn signals is reserved for emergency vehicles.

sec07-F43-card.front: At most how many front lamps rated three hundred candlepower or higher may shine at the same time?
sec07-F43-card.expected_back: No more than four front lamps rated at least three hundred candlepower may be illuminated simultaneously.

sec07-F44-card.front: Between what minimum and maximum heights above the ground must a headlamp's center sit?
sec07-F44-card.expected_back: The center of a headlamp must sit between twenty-four and fifty-four inches above ground.

sec07-F45-card.front: May an ordinary motor vehicle display a red light visible from the front?
sec07-F45-card.expected_back: A red light visible from the front is prohibited on an ordinary motor vehicle; emergency vehicles are excepted.

sec07-F46-card.front: Which three vehicle types are listed among exceptions to Delaware's general ban on flashing lights?
sec07-F46-card.expected_back: Emergency vehicles, school buses and snow-removal equipment are among the exceptions to the general flashing-light prohibition.

sec07-F47-card.front: What special revolving or flashing light color may snow-removal equipment display?
sec07-F47-card.expected_back: Snow-removal equipment may use green revolving or flashing lights.

sec07-F48-card.front: Which two flashing-light functions are legal on ordinary passenger vehicles?
sec07-F48-card.expected_back: Turn signals and four-way hazard flashers are permitted flashing-light uses.

sec07-F49-card.front: Are unauthorized frames, symbols, or accessories allowed on a Delaware license plate?
sec07-F49-card.expected_back: Unauthorized additions such as frames, symbols or accessories on a license plate are forbidden.

sec07-F50-card.front: When is installing a lamp or reflector prohibited on a vehicle?
sec07-F50-card.expected_back: A lamp or reflector must not be installed if it tends to alter the vehicle’s original design or performance.

sec07-F51-card.front: During what exact date span are studded tires permitted in Delaware?
sec07-F51-card.expected_back: Studded tires are allowed in Delaware from October fifteen through April fifteen, including both endpoints.

sec07-F52-card.front: During what Delaware dates are studded tires banned, and what rule applies out of state?
sec07-F52-card.expected_back: Studded tires are prohibited in Delaware from April sixteen through October fourteen; drivers must follow other states’ rules while traveling there.

sec07-F53-card.front: Is using a muffler cut-out legal on Delaware roads?
sec07-F53-card.expected_back: Using a muffler cut-out is forbidden.

sec07-F54-card.front: Which three loud audible devices are prohibited on ordinary motor vehicles?
sec07-F54-card.expected_back: Ordinary vehicles may not carry a siren or an exhaust or compression whistle.

sec07-F55-card.front: How many vehicles may a motor vehicle generally tow, and what exception applies to a tractor with a semitrailer?
sec07-F55-card.expected_back: A motor vehicle generally may tow only one vehicle; a tractor with a semitrailer may tow one additional vehicle.

sec07-F56-card.front: What is the maximum legal length of the connection between a towing vehicle and a towed vehicle?
sec07-F56-card.expected_back: The connection between towing and towed vehicles must measure no more than fifteen feet.

sec07-F57-card.front: What marker must be attached when towing with a chain, cable, or rope?
sec07-F57-card.expected_back: A chain, cable or rope used for towing needs an attached red flag at least twelve inches square.

sec07-F58-card.front: Which portion of the front windshield is covered by Delaware's tint restriction?
sec07-F58-card.expected_back: The windshield tint restriction covers the area below the upper five inches, with the source also referring to an AS-one boundary.

sec07-F59-card.front: Which two exterior vehicle items must never be covered with tint material?
sec07-F59-card.expected_back: Tint material must not cover vehicle lights or the license plate.

sec07-F60-card.front: What mirror equipment must a vehicle have if it is fitted with window tint?
sec07-F60-card.expected_back: A vehicle fitted with tint needs exterior mirrors on its left and right sides.

sec07-F61-card.front: What document is required to have aftermarket tint on the windows immediately beside the driver?
sec07-F61-card.expected_back: Aftermarket tint immediately beside the driver requires a valid approved waiver kept in the vehicle.

sec07-F62-card.front: Between which daily light milestones must headlights be used while driving?
sec07-F62-card.expected_back: Headlights must be used during driving between sunset and sunrise.

sec07-F63-card.front: At what visibility cutoff must you turn on your headlights even during daytime?
sec07-F63-card.expected_back: Headlights are required whenever visibility does not extend beyond one thousand feet.

sec07-F64-card.front: What does Delaware's headlight-use subsection require whenever your windshield wipers are running?
sec07-F64-card.expected_back: The headlight-use subsection requires headlights whenever the windshield wipers are used.

sec07-F65-card.front: How many feet before meeting an oncoming vehicle must you switch to low beams?
sec07-F65-card.expected_back: Use low beams beginning five hundred feet before meeting another vehicle.

sec07-F66-card.front: Within what following distance behind another vehicle must you use low beams?
sec07-F66-card.expected_back: Use low beams when following within two hundred feet of another vehicle.

sec07-F67-card.front: What restraint requirement applies to every occupant in a vehicle?
sec07-F67-card.expected_back: Every vehicle occupant must be secured correctly by a belt or child safety seat.

sec07-F68-card.front: Can a police officer pull a vehicle over solely for seeing an unbuckled occupant?
sec07-F68-card.expected_back: An officer may stop a vehicle upon seeing an occupant without a belt.

sec07-F69-card.front: Who receives the citation when passengers are unbuckled or improperly restrained?
sec07-F69-card.expected_back: The driver is ticketed for occupants who are unrestrained or restrained incorrectly.

sec07-R01-card.front: What kind of insurance policy establishes financial responsibility for titling and registering a vehicle in Delaware?
sec07-R01-card.expected_back: Obtaining liability insurance from an insurer licensed to operate in Delaware establishes the owner’s financial responsibility for titling and registration.

sec07-R02-card.front: What is Delaware's minimum personal-injury protection coverage for one person hurt in a crash?
sec07-R02-card.expected_back: Minimum personal-injury protection is fifteen thousand dollars for one person injured in a crash.

sec07-R03-card.front: What is Delaware's minimum personal-injury protection total for all people injured in a single crash?
sec07-R03-card.expected_back: Minimum personal-injury protection is thirty thousand dollars for all people injured in one crash.

sec07-R04-card.front: What is the minimum liability coverage for bodily injury or death of one person in a crash?
sec07-R04-card.expected_back: Minimum liability coverage for one person’s bodily injury or death in a crash is twenty-five thousand dollars.

sec07-R05-card.front: What minimum bodily-injury or death liability coverage applies when two or more people are hurt in one crash?
sec07-R05-card.expected_back: Minimum liability coverage for bodily injury or death of at least two people in a crash is fifty thousand dollars.

sec07-R06-card.front: What minimum coverage amount protects against damaging someone else's property in a crash?
sec07-R06-card.expected_back: Minimum coverage for damage to other people’s property in a crash is ten thousand dollars.

sec07-R07-card.front: In what formats is an original Delaware insurance identification card accepted?
sec07-R07-card.expected_back: An original Delaware insurance identification card is an acceptable insurance document and may be electronic or paper.

sec07-R08-card.front: Where must the insurance card stay, and which three pieces of policy info must it show?
sec07-R08-card.expected_back: The insurance card must stay in the vehicle and show coverage dates, a valid expiration and the insurer’s NAIC code.

sec07-R09-card.front: How often are Delaware insurance identification cards reissued?
sec07-R09-card.expected_back: Insurance identification cards are issued again every six months.

sec07-R10-card.front: Can a valid insurance policy itself serve as acceptable proof of coverage?
sec07-R10-card.expected_back: A valid insurance policy is accepted as proof of coverage.

sec07-R11-card.front: For how long and in what format is a written insurance binder acceptable?
sec07-R11-card.expected_back: A written binder is acceptable within thirty days after issue when supplied by an insurer or agent on the insurer’s letterhead.

sec07-R12-card.front: When does the DMV accept faxed proof of insurance, and what fax source is rejected?
sec07-R12-card.expected_back: Faxed insurance proof is accepted only when the insurer sends it directly to the DMV; a third-party fax is rejected.

sec07-R13-card.front: What check applies when you present electronic proof of insurance?
sec07-R13-card.expected_back: Electronic insurance proof is subject to verification.

sec07-R14-card.front: What fine range applies for driving an uninsured vehicle in Delaware?
sec07-R14-card.expected_back: Driving an uninsured vehicle carries a fine from one thousand five hundred dollars to two thousand dollars.

sec07-R15-card.front: What fine range applies to a subsequent uninsured-driving offense within three years?
sec07-R15-card.expected_back: A later uninsured-driving offense within three years of an earlier offense carries a three thousand dollars to four thousand dollars fine.

sec07-R16-card.front: What additional penalties apply for presenting false insurance proof?
sec07-R16-card.expected_back: False insurance proof brings an additional five hundred dollars fine, thirty days in jail, or both.

sec07-R17-card.front: Who may remove a vehicle's license plate after proper owner notice when affirmative insurance proof is missing?
sec07-R17-card.expected_back: After proper notice to the owner, authorized insurance personnel or law-enforcement officials may take the plate when affirmative insurance proof is absent.

sec07-R18-card.front: What must a vehicle owner do with a valid license plate before canceling insurance?
sec07-R18-card.expected_back: Before canceling insurance, the owner must surrender a valid plate to the DMV or face fines.

sec07-R19-card.front: How does the DMV check whether active Delaware registrations maintain insurance?
sec07-R19-card.expected_back: The DMV conducts random insurance-proof audits of active registrations.

sec07-R20-card.front: How is the uninsured audit penalty calculated across the first thirty days and each day afterward?
sec07-R20-card.expected_back: The insurance-audit penalty is one hundred dollars for the first one to thirty uninsured days, then five dollars daily until insurance, tag surrender or registration expiration.

sec07-R21-card.front: What happens if a vehicle owner fails to respond to a DMV insurance-audit request?
sec07-R21-card.expected_back: An owner’s failure to answer an insurance-audit request results in registration suspension.

sec07-R22-card.front: How much does it cost per registration to reinstate after an insurance-audit suspension?
sec07-R22-card.expected_back: Reinstating a suspended registration after the insurance-audit process costs fifty dollars per registration.

sec07-R23-card.front: Where does vehicle inspection fit in the order of Delaware's title and registration process?
sec07-R23-card.expected_back: Vehicle inspection is the second step in the Delaware title and registration process.

sec07-R24-card.front: Which vehicle ownership or registration document must you bring to inspection?
sec07-R24-card.expected_back: A title certificate or registration card must be presented for inspection.

sec07-R25-card.front: How much are Delaware residents charged for state vehicle inspection?
sec07-R25-card.expected_back: Delaware residents are not charged for vehicle inspection.

sec07-R26-card.front: What three conditions must vehicle lamps meet during Delaware inspection?
sec07-R26-card.expected_back: Inspection requires lamps to work, be clean and have correct aim.

sec07-R27-card.front: Which stopping check is performed on every vehicle brought through Delaware inspection?
sec07-R27-card.expected_back: Every vehicle brought for inspection receives a brake-performance test.

sec07-R28-card.front: What two conditions must mirrors satisfy to pass inspection?
sec07-R28-card.expected_back: Inspection mirrors must be intact and clean.

sec07-R29-card.front: What operating and blade conditions must windshield wipers meet for inspection?
sec07-R29-card.expected_back: Inspection wipers must work fully and have sound rubber blades.

sec07-R30-card.front: How securely must hood and trunk latches hold their panels for inspection?
sec07-R30-card.expected_back: Hood and trunk latches must keep their panels completely closed.

sec07-R31-card.front: Which four surface defects disqualify tires during a Delaware safety inspection?
sec07-R31-card.expected_back: Inspection tires may not have cuts, bulges, bald patches or exposed fabric.

sec07-R32-card.front: What minimum tread depth across how many neighboring grooves is required at inspection?
sec07-R32-card.expected_back: Inspection tread depth must reach at least two thirty-seconds inch in two neighboring treads.

sec07-R33-card.front: What door hardware is required to pass Delaware vehicle inspection?
sec07-R33-card.expected_back: Working door handles or an equivalent mechanism must be present.

sec07-R34-card.front: How does Delaware inspection treat damaged or displaced body parts that stick out dangerously?
sec07-R34-card.expected_back: Damaged or displaced protruding parts that create a safety hazard are unacceptable.

sec07-R35-card.front: Must the vehicle's horn operate properly to pass state inspection?
sec07-R35-card.expected_back: The horn must function for inspection.

sec07-R36-card.front: What two muffler and exhaust-system conditions are required at Delaware inspection?
sec07-R36-card.expected_back: The inspection requires a noise-reducing muffler and an exhaust system without leaks.

sec07-R37-card.front: When must a vehicle have a catalytic converter installed for inspection?
sec07-R37-card.expected_back: A catalytic converter is required when the manufacturer originally fitted one.

sec07-R38-card.front: Which three visible fluid leaks will fail a vehicle at Delaware inspection?
sec07-R38-card.expected_back: No visible fuel, oil or coolant leakage is allowed for inspection.

sec07-R39-card.front: What seat-belt rule applies while driving through the inspection lane itself?
sec07-R39-card.expected_back: Seat belts must be worn at inspection.

sec07-R40-card.front: How high above the ground may the bottom of a passenger-car bumper sit?
sec07-R40-card.expected_back: A passenger-car bumper’s bottom may be no higher than twenty-two inches above ground.

sec07-R41-card.front: What is the maximum legal gap allowed between a vehicle's body and frame rail?
sec07-R41-card.expected_back: The gap between the body and frame rail may not exceed three inches.

sec07-R42-card.front: How tall may a hood-mounted air scoop be under Delaware inspection rules?
sec07-R42-card.expected_back: A hood-mounted air scoop may not exceed three inches.

sec07-R43-card.front: Which model-year span is tested specifically for tailpipe exhaust emissions?
sec07-R43-card.expected_back: Vehicles from model years nineteen sixty-eight through nineteen ninety-five are tested for exhaust emissions.

sec07-R44-card.front: Which gasoline vehicles receive an OBD-II diagnostic test at inspection?
sec07-R44-card.expected_back: Gas-powered vehicles from nineteen ninety-six onward weighing under eight thousand pounds receive an OBD-II test.

sec07-R45-card.front: Which heavier gas or diesel model years and GVWR range also receive OBD-II testing?
sec07-R45-card.expected_back: Gas or diesel vehicles from two thousand eight onward with GVWR from eight thousand five hundred one to fourteen thousand receive OBD-II testing.

sec07-R46-card.front: How long must a windshield crack be to trigger mandatory inspection failure?
sec07-R46-card.expected_back: A windshield crack longer than five inches is a mandatory inspection failure.

sec07-R47-card.front: What size star chip on a windshield causes mandatory inspection failure?
sec07-R47-card.expected_back: A star chip larger than one inch is a mandatory windshield inspection failure.

sec07-R48-card.front: What is the minimum vertical visibility height required for a windshield?
sec07-R48-card.expected_back: Windshield visibility height must be at least ten inches.

sec07-R49-card.front: Which newer model years skip regular inspection, and what check still applies if never titled in Delaware?
sec07-R49-card.expected_back: Vehicles seven model years old or newer avoid inspection except a VIN inspection if never titled in Delaware.

sec07-R50-card.front: What inspection-free renewal option applies specifically to vehicles that are seven years old?
sec07-R50-card.expected_back: Vehicles seven years old receive a one-year renewal without inspection.

sec07-R51-card.front: What late fee applies when you renew vehicle registration after it has expired?
sec07-R51-card.expected_back: Renewing after registration expiration incurs a twenty dollars late fee.

sec07-R52-card.front: What three steps must happen after an unsafe or improperly equipped vehicle is rejected at inspection?
sec07-R52-card.expected_back: An unsafe, improperly equipped or improperly repaired vehicle is rejected and must be corrected, reinspected and passed before title, registration and plate issuance.

sec07-R53-card.front: When may an owner nearing registration expiration get a twenty-dollar temporary tag after failing inspection?
sec07-R53-card.expected_back: An owner nearing registration expiration may qualify for a twenty dollars temporary tag when the inspection failure is unrelated to safety.

sec07-R54-card.front: After securing insurance and passing inspection, what is the third step in registering a vehicle?
sec07-R54-card.expected_back: The third registration step is applying for a Delaware title and registration.

sec07-R55-card.front: What must be done with an existing title certificate from a title-issuing state when applying in Delaware?
sec07-R55-card.expected_back: A title certificate from a title-issuing state must be surrendered to the DMV when applying.

sec07-R56-card.front: Which DMV form is used to request an out-of-state title held by a lender?
sec07-R56-card.expected_back: When a lien prevents obtaining the title, the DMV provides form MV-thirty-five for requesting it from the lienholder.

sec07-R57-card.front: Which title-application and inspection form does the lane technician issue once safety and emissions pass?
sec07-R57-card.expected_back: After emissions and safety inspections are passed, the technician supplies the MV-two hundred twelve title application and inspection report.

sec07-R58-card.front: Which signatures satisfy a Delaware title and registration application?
sec07-R58-card.expected_back: The application requires all owners’ signatures, an authorized person with original power of attorney, or a company officer’s signature.

sec07-R59-card.front: What document-fee percentage, valuation basis, and minimum dollar floor normally apply when titling an out-of-state vehicle?
sec07-R59-card.expected_back: An out-of-state vehicle brought for Delaware titling or registration normally has a document fee of five point two five percent of its current NADA average trade-in value, with an eight dollars minimum.

sec07-R60-card.front: What proof exempts an incoming vehicle from Delaware's document fee?
sec07-R60-card.expected_back: The document-fee exception requires proof of a sales, transfer or similar vehicle-purchase levy paid to another state within the preceding ninety days.

sec07-R61-card.front: What document-fee percentage applies specifically to mobile homes in Delaware?
sec07-R61-card.expected_back: The handbook gives a three point seven five percent document fee for mobile homes.

sec07-R62-card.front: Must liability-insurance proof be presented when titling or registering a vehicle?
sec07-R62-card.expected_back: Liability-insurance proof must be provided when a vehicle is titled or registered.

sec07-R63-card.front: How much is Delaware's vehicle title fee when there is no lien?
sec07-R63-card.expected_back: The title fee without a lien is thirty-five dollars.

sec07-R64-card.front: How much is Delaware's vehicle title fee when a lender's lien is recorded?
sec07-R64-card.expected_back: The title fee with a lien is fifty-five dollars.

sec07-R65-card.front: Who receives the paper title when a lien exists, and what must the customer provide?
sec07-R65-card.expected_back: When a lien exists, the title goes to the lienholder and the customer must supply the correct address.

sec07-R66-card.front: How much does one year of Delaware passenger-vehicle registration cost?
sec07-R66-card.expected_back: Passenger-vehicle registration costs forty dollars for one year.

sec07-R67-card.front: How much does a two-year Delaware passenger-vehicle registration cost?
sec07-R67-card.expected_back: Passenger-vehicle registration costs eighty dollars for two years.

sec07-R68-card.front: What determines how many registration years—from one to seven—a vehicle in its first seven model years can get?
sec07-R68-card.expected_back: During a vehicle’s first seven model years, its model year determines eligibility for registration lasting one to seven years.

sec07-R69-card.front: How much does a six-month Delaware registration cost?

sec07-R70-card.front: On what date do Delaware's extra annual registration fees for alternative-fuel vehicles take effect?
sec07-R70-card.expected_back: Additional registration fees for alternative-fuel vehicles start October one, two thousand twenty-five in the handbook.

sec07-R71-card.front: How much is the extra yearly registration surcharge on a pure EV rated six thousand pounds or under?
sec07-R71-card.expected_back: The extra annual registration fee for an electric vehicle with GVWR six thousand pounds or less is one hundred ten dollars.

sec07-R72-card.front: How much is the extra yearly registration surcharge on a pure EV over six thousand up to ten thousand pounds?
sec07-R72-card.expected_back: The extra annual registration fee for an electric vehicle with GVWR above six thousand through ten thousand pounds is one hundred fifty dollars.

sec07-R73-card.front: How much is the extra yearly registration surcharge on a pure EV over ten thousand up to twenty-six thousand pounds?
sec07-R73-card.expected_back: The extra annual registration fee for an electric vehicle with GVWR above ten thousand through twenty-six thousand pounds is two hundred sixty dollars.

sec07-R74-card.front: How much is the extra yearly registration surcharge on a pure EV rated over twenty-six thousand pounds?
sec07-R74-card.expected_back: The extra annual registration fee for an electric vehicle with GVWR above twenty-six thousand pounds is nine hundred dollars.

sec07-R75-card.front: How much is the extra yearly registration surcharge on a plug-in EV rated six thousand pounds or under?
sec07-R75-card.expected_back: The extra annual registration fee for an plug-in electric vehicle with GVWR six thousand pounds or less is eighty-five dollars.

sec07-R76-card.front: What extra annual registration fee applies to a plug-in electric vehicle above six thousand through ten thousand pounds?
sec07-R76-card.expected_back: The extra annual registration fee for an plug-in electric vehicle with GVWR above six thousand through ten thousand pounds is one hundred fifteen dollars.

sec07-R77-card.front: What extra annual registration fee applies to a plug-in electric vehicle above ten thousand through twenty-six thousand pounds?
sec07-R77-card.expected_back: The extra annual registration fee for an plug-in electric vehicle with GVWR above ten thousand through twenty-six thousand pounds is two hundred dollars.

sec07-R78-card.front: What extra annual registration fee applies to a plug-in electric vehicle above twenty-six thousand pounds?
sec07-R78-card.expected_back: The extra annual registration fee for an plug-in electric vehicle with GVWR above twenty-six thousand pounds is six hundred dollars.

sec07-R79-card.front: How much is the extra yearly registration surcharge on a non-plug-in hybrid rated six thousand pounds or under?
sec07-R79-card.expected_back: The extra annual registration fee for an non-plug-in hybrid vehicle with GVWR six thousand pounds or less is sixty dollars.

sec07-R80-card.front: What extra annual registration fee applies to a non-plug-in hybrid above six thousand through ten thousand pounds?
sec07-R80-card.expected_back: The extra annual registration fee for an non-plug-in hybrid vehicle with GVWR above six thousand through ten thousand pounds is eighty dollars.

sec07-R81-card.front: What extra annual registration fee applies to a non-plug-in hybrid above ten thousand through twenty-six thousand pounds?
sec07-R81-card.expected_back: The extra annual registration fee for an non-plug-in hybrid vehicle with GVWR above ten thousand through twenty-six thousand pounds is one hundred forty dollars.

sec07-R82-card.front: What extra annual registration fee applies to a non-plug-in hybrid vehicle above twenty-six thousand pounds?
sec07-R82-card.expected_back: The extra annual registration fee for an non-plug-in hybrid vehicle with GVWR above twenty-six thousand pounds is four hundred eighty dollars.

sec07-R83-card.front: What extra annual registration fee applies to a hydrogen, natural-gas, or other-fuel vehicle of six thousand pounds or less?
sec07-R83-card.expected_back: The extra annual registration fee for an other-fuel, including hydrogen or natural gas vehicle with GVWR six thousand pounds or less is one hundred ten dollars.

sec07-R84-card.front: What extra annual registration fee applies to an other-fuel vehicle above six thousand through ten thousand pounds?
sec07-R84-card.expected_back: The extra annual registration fee for an other-fuel, including hydrogen or natural gas vehicle with GVWR above six thousand through ten thousand pounds is one hundred fifty dollars.

sec07-R85-card.front: What extra annual registration fee applies to an other-fuel vehicle above ten thousand through twenty-six thousand pounds?
sec07-R85-card.expected_back: The extra annual registration fee for an other-fuel, including hydrogen or natural gas vehicle with GVWR above ten thousand through twenty-six thousand pounds is two hundred sixty dollars.

sec07-R86-card.front: What extra annual registration fee applies to an other-fuel vehicle above twenty-six thousand pounds?
sec07-R86-card.expected_back: The extra annual registration fee for an other-fuel, including hydrogen or natural gas vehicle with GVWR above twenty-six thousand pounds is nine hundred dollars.

sec07-R87-card.front: What three items does the DMV issue once paperwork clears and document, title, and registration fees are paid?
sec07-R87-card.expected_back: Once required documents are accepted and document, title and registration fees are paid, the DMV issues the title, registration card and plate; a lienholder receives the title when applicable.

sec07-R88-card.front: Who must sign consent when someone under age eighteen applies for a Delaware vehicle title?
sec07-R88-card.expected_back: An applicant younger than eighteen needs a parent, guardian or documented court-appointed custodian to sign consent for a title application.

sec07-R89-card.front: What two proofs must be presented before renewing a Delaware vehicle registration?
sec07-R89-card.expected_back: Before registration renewal, proof of adequate liability insurance and the required safety and emissions inspections must be presented.

sec07-R90-card.front: How early before expiration may you inspect a vehicle, and does renewing early shorten your registration term?
sec07-R90-card.expected_back: A vehicle may be inspected during the ninety days before registration expiration, and early renewal does not reduce the registration term.

sec07-R91-card.front: Which group is exempted from Delaware's twenty-dollar late registration renewal fee?
sec07-R91-card.expected_back: Active-duty military personnel are excepted from the late-renewal fee as described in the handbook’s fee chart.

sec07-R92-card.front: Up to what weight do trailers skip a new inspection before registration renewal?
sec07-R92-card.expected_back: Trailers of four thousand pounds or less do not need a new inspection before registration renewal.

sec07-R93-card.front: How far ahead and by what three channels are mail-renewal-eligible owners notified before expiration?
sec07-R93-card.memory_hook: Ninety days via mail, email, phone
sec07-R93-card.expected_back: Owners eligible for mail renewal are notified by mail, email or telephone ninety days before registration expiration.

sec07-R94-card.front: Within how many days and to which DMV sections must you report a Delaware address change?
sec07-R94-card.expected_back: A Delaware address change must be reported within thirty days to both the DMV’s vehicle and driver-license sections.

sec07-R95-card.front: How can you update a registration address, and what fee applies to the replacement card in the written process?
sec07-R95-card.expected_back: A registration address can be changed online or by writing to Vehicle Services; the DMV sends a replacement registration card without a fee for the written process.

sec07-R96-card.front: After a legal name change, which card must be updated first and how many days do you have for title and registration?
sec07-R96-card.expected_back: After changing a name, the owner has thirty days to apply for a replacement title and registration, after first changing the driver license.

sec07-R97-card.front: Which four documents are required to update your name on a Delaware vehicle record?
sec07-R97-card.expected_back: A vehicle name change requires the title, prior registration, insurance proof, and a marriage certificate or court order.

sec07-R98-card.front: How much do replacement title and registration cost for a name change without a lien versus with a lien?
sec07-R98-card.expected_back: A replacement title and registration for a name change costs thirty-five dollars, or fifty-five dollars when a lien exists.

sec07-R99-card.front: How far outside Delaware must a resident be temporarily living to qualify for mail registration renewal?
sec07-R99-card.expected_back: Delaware residents temporarily living more than two hundred miles outside the state may renew registration by mail.

sec07-R100-card.front: Which two vehicle documents must stay with the car every time it is driven?
sec07-R100-card.expected_back: The registration certificate and liability-insurance proof must travel with the vehicle whenever it is driven.

sec07-R101-card.front: Where must the license plate and its expiration sticker be mounted on the vehicle?
sec07-R101-card.expected_back: The plate must be attached at the designated rear location, with the expiration-month-and-year sticker at its lower right.

sec07-R102-card.front: At what exact time does Delaware vehicle registration expire, and is there any grace period?
sec07-R102-card.expected_back: Registration ends at midnight on the date shown by the sticker, with no grace period.

sec09-F01-card.front: What does Delaware law require if you want to hold a phone conversation while driving?
sec09-F01-card.expected_back: Delaware prohibits texting and handheld phone use while driving; phone conversations require hands-free equipment.

sec09-F02-card.front: What must a driver immediately do after dialing, activating, or turning off wireless equipment?
sec09-F02-card.expected_back: A driver may dial or activate or deactivate wireless equipment, then must set the device down.

sec09-F03-card.front: Besides cell phones, which other handheld electronic communication devices are restricted while driving?
sec09-F03-card.expected_back: The driving restriction also covers handheld electronic communication devices such as pagers, portable computers and two-way communication devices.

sec09-F04-card.front: May a driver holding a Graduated Driver License use a hands-free phone or electronic device while driving?
sec09-F04-card.expected_back: A driver holding a GDL may not use a phone or electronic device while driving, even hands-free.

sec09-F05-card.front: Which urgent situations or roles are exempted from Delaware's driving device-use ban?
sec09-F05-card.expected_back: Authorized emergency-vehicle operators performing official duties and people reporting emergencies are excepted from the device-use restriction.

sec09-F06-card.front: Which farm-vehicle operators and radio users are specifically exempted from the electronic device restriction?
sec09-F06-card.expected_back: The device-use exemptions include operators of farm tractors, unregistered farm trucks or farm equipment, and HAM radio operators.

sec09-F07-card.front: When may a business or government worker legally use a two-way radio while operating a vehicle?
sec09-F07-card.expected_back: A business or government employee may use an attached or mounted two-way vehicle radio to communicate with dispatch, a base or other employees under the listed exemption.

sec09-F08-card.front: How far ahead must you give a hand or turn signal before stopping, turning, or changing lanes?
sec09-F08-card.expected_back: A driver must communicate an intended stop, turn or lane change by hand signal or turn signal three hundred feet before the action.

sec09-F09-card.front: When overtaking another vehicle on the left, when is it safe to move back into the right lane?
sec09-F09-card.expected_back: When passing to the left, keep a safe distance and return right only after safely clearing the other vehicle.

sec09-F10-card.front: What minimum lateral clearance must you maintain throughout the entire pass around a bicyclist?
sec09-F10-card.expected_back: Passing a cyclist requires at least three feet of clearance throughout the pass.

sec09-F11-card.front: How must you pass a cyclist on a multilane road whenever traffic conditions allow?
sec09-F11-card.expected_back: On a multilane road, a driver passing a cyclist must use the neighboring lane whenever possible.

sec09-F12-card.front: What must you do with your lane position and speed when another driver is overtaking you?
sec09-F12-card.expected_back: A vehicle being passed must give way right and avoid accelerating until the pass is complete.

sec09-F13-card.front: How must you respond to an approaching emergency vehicle using a siren or alternating red lights unless an officer directs otherwise?
sec09-F13-card.expected_back: For an approaching authorized emergency vehicle using a siren or the listed alternating red-light combinations, yield and move immediately to the right edge clear of intersections until it passes, unless police direct otherwise.

sec09-F14-card.front: Which transportation-agency operators are also covered by the approaching-emergency-vehicle yield law during an incident?
sec09-F14-card.expected_back: The approaching-emergency-vehicle law also extends to DelDOT operators requested to support police or fire personnel at an incident.

sec09-F15-card.front: What is your primary duty when approaching a stopped emergency, DelDOT, tow, or warning-displaying vehicle on the roadside?
sec09-F15-card.expected_back: When approaching a stationary emergency, DelDOT, tow or other vehicle giving the described warnings, proceed cautiously and change lanes to yield when possible.

sec09-F16-card.front: What must you do under the move-over law if changing lanes is unsafe or impossible?
sec09-F16-card.expected_back: If moving over would be unsafe or impossible, proceed carefully and slow to a safe speed.

sec09-F17-card.front: Which alternating warning-light color combinations trigger the move-over rule for stationary emergency vehicles?
sec09-F17-card.expected_back: The listed alternating warning colors for stationary emergency vehicles are red alone, blue alone, blue paired with white, red paired with white or blue, and the red-white-blue combination.

sec09-F18-card.front: Which alternating light colors identify a stationary DelDOT vehicle under the move-over law?
sec09-F18-card.expected_back: The stationary DelDOT warning described in the move-over rule uses alternating amber or red-and-amber lights.

sec09-F19-card.front: Which alternating warning lights on a stationary tow truck require drivers to move over or slow down?
sec09-F19-card.expected_back: The stationary tow-truck warning described in the move-over rule uses alternating amber, white or amber-and-white lights.

sec09-F20-card.front: Which roadside signals on any ordinary stopped vehicle also trigger Delaware's move-over requirement?
sec09-F20-card.expected_back: The move-over rule also includes a stationary vehicle displaying hazard lights, flares, cones, caution signs or other nonvehicle warning signs.

sec09-F21-card.front: How must you position your car when passing a protected stopped vehicle on a multilane roadway?
sec09-F21-card.expected_back: On a multilane roadway, move one lane away from a stopped vehicle until safely beyond it.

sec09-F22-card.front: What speed adjustment is required when passing a stopped roadside vehicle on a two-lane road?
sec09-F22-card.expected_back: On a two-lane roadway, slow below the posted limit until completely beyond the stopped vehicle.

sec09-F23-card.front: Which groups of roadway users are bound by Delaware traffic laws on public highways?
sec09-F23-card.expected_back: Delaware traffic laws apply to all highway users, including drivers, cyclists, people guiding vehicles or riding animals, and pedestrians.

sec09-F24-card.front: What must you do when a police officer's hand direction conflicts with a traffic light, sign, or pavement marking?
sec09-F24-card.expected_back: Follow a police officer’s instructions even when they conflict with signs, signals, markings or usual traffic laws.

sec09-F25-card.front: Is it legal to cut through a gas station or private lot to avoid waiting at a traffic sign or red light?
sec09-F25-card.expected_back: Do not bypass a traffic sign or signal by leaving the roadway and crossing private property.

sec09-F26-card.front: What emergency contact resource is posted at every railroad grade crossing?
sec09-F26-card.expected_back: Every grade crossing has an emergency dispatch number for reporting crossing, track or train problems to the railroad.

sec09-F27-card.front: Where do you normally find the railroad emergency notification phone number at a crossing?
sec09-F27-card.expected_back: The railroad emergency notification number is normally on a blue sign at the crossbuck or near the crossing.

sec09-F28-card.front: What information on the blue ENS sign pinpoints the exact railroad crossing for responders and rail crews?
sec09-F28-card.expected_back: The ENS sign’s DOT number identifies the crossing location for responders and railroad personnel.

sec09-F29-card.front: How does reading the crossing's DOT number to the railroad dispatcher help prevent a train collision?
sec09-F29-card.expected_back: Giving the dispatcher the crossing’s DOT number helps locate a blockage so approaching trains can be slowed or stopped.

sec09-F30-card.front: Should you ever try to beat an approaching train across a railroad grade crossing?
sec09-F30-card.expected_back: Never attempt to race a train through a railroad crossing.

sec09-F31-card.front: When must you wait before starting across railroad tracks even if no train is currently visible?
sec09-F31-card.expected_back: Do not start across tracks unless the far side has enough room for the entire vehicle without stopping on the tracks.

sec09-F32-card.front: Why does the Delaware handbook advise against shifting gears while crossing railroad tracks?
sec09-F32-card.expected_back: The handbook recommends avoiding gear changes while traversing tracks because of the risk of stalling.

sec09-F33-card.front: What shape, color, and markings identify an advance railroad-crossing warning sign?
sec09-F33-card.expected_back: The advance railroad warning is a round yellow sign bearing a black X and RR letters.

sec09-F34-card.front: Which three elements commonly appear in advance pavement markings before a railroad crossing?
sec09-F34-card.expected_back: Rail-crossing advance pavement markings commonly contain an X, RR letters and a stopping bar.

sec09-F35-card.front: Which standard traffic sign shares the exact same legal meaning as a white X-shaped railroad crossbuck?
sec09-F35-card.expected_back: A white X-shaped railroad crossbuck has the meaning of a yield sign and requires yielding to trains.

sec09-F36-card.front: What action is required when side-by-side red lights begin flashing at a railroad crossing?
sec09-F36-card.expected_back: Flashing side-by-side railroad-crossing lights require a stop.

sec09-F37-card.front: May you weave around a lowered railroad crossing gate if you do not see a train coming?
sec09-F37-card.expected_back: Never drive around a lowered railroad gate.

sec09-F38-card.front: When a railroad crossing bell is ringing, how long must you wait before driving across?
sec09-F38-card.expected_back: Where a crossing bell sounds, do not cross until it stops.

sec09-F39-card.front: What does a track-count plaque warn you about, and what should you verify even if none is posted?
sec09-F39-card.expected_back: A track-count sign warns of multiple tracks and possible additional trains; even without one, check for more than one track.

sec09-F40-card.front: What part of the roadway is marked by a solid white line along the right side?
sec09-F40-card.expected_back: A solid white road-edge line identifies the outer edge of the travel lane.

sec09-F41-card.front: What direction of traffic flow is separated by white lane markings?
sec09-F41-card.expected_back: White lane markings separate traffic lanes moving in the same direction.

sec09-F42-card.front: When may you cross a broken white line between travel lanes?
sec09-F42-card.expected_back: A broken white lane line may be crossed for a safe lane change.

sec09-F43-card.front: What does a single solid white line between same-direction lanes tell drivers about changing lanes?
sec09-F43-card.expected_back: A single solid white lane line discourages changing lanes.

sec09-F44-card.front: What is the legal rule for crossing a double solid white line between lanes?
sec09-F44-card.expected_back: A double solid white lane line prohibits changing lanes.

sec09-F45-card.front: Where must your vehicle come to rest when a sign or traffic signal requires a stop?
sec09-F45-card.expected_back: When a sign or signal requires stopping, stop before reaching the stopping line or crosswalk.

sec09-F46-card.front: Do crosswalks only exist where white lines are painted across the pavement?
sec09-F46-card.expected_back: A crosswalk can exist without painted markings, so remain alert for pedestrians at intersections.

sec09-F47-card.front: What does yellow center-line paint tell you about the traffic on the other side of the line?
sec09-F47-card.expected_back: Yellow lines separate opposing directions of traffic.

sec09-F48-card.front: When is a driver allowed to cross a single broken yellow center line?
sec09-F48-card.expected_back: A broken yellow center line may be crossed to pass when safe.

sec09-F49-card.front: May you cross center lines to pass when the solid yellow stripe is on your side and the broken stripe is opposite?
sec09-F49-card.memory_hook: Solid side on yours forbids passing
sec09-F49-card.expected_back: Where opposing lanes have one solid and one broken yellow line, passing is prohibited from the solid-line side.

sec09-F50-card.front: When a solid yellow line and a broken yellow line sit side by side, which direction of traffic may pass?
sec09-F50-card.expected_back: Where a solid and broken yellow line are paired, a driver on the broken-line side may pass safely.

sec09-F51-card.front: What passing rule applies where two solid yellow lines divide the roadway?
sec09-F51-card.expected_back: Two solid yellow center lines prohibit passing from either direction.

sec09-F52-card.front: When is it legal to cross a solid yellow line on the roadway?
sec09-F52-card.expected_back: A solid yellow line may be crossed for a safe turn into a driveway.

sec09-F53-card.front: How are reversible rush-hour lanes normally marked on the pavement, and what must you verify before entering?
sec09-F53-card.expected_back: Reversible lanes change travel direction at different times and are normally marked with paired broken yellow lines; check which lane is available before entering.

sec09-F54-card.front: What does a downward green arrow displayed over a reversible lane indicate?
sec09-F54-card.expected_back: A green arrow above a reversible lane allows use of that lane.

sec09-F55-card.front: What does a steady red X over a reversible lane command?
sec09-F55-card.expected_back: A red X above a reversible lane prohibits its use.

sec09-F56-card.front: What must you do when an overhead lane signal displays a steady yellow X?
sec09-F56-card.expected_back: A steady yellow X means lane use is changing; leave the lane as soon as safely possible.

sec09-F57-card.front: Who may use lanes marked Transit or Bus, and who may use lanes marked Bicycle?
sec09-F57-card.expected_back: A lane marked Transit or Bus is reserved for buses, while a Bicycle designation reserves it for bicycles.

sec09-F58-card.front: What two details do HOV lane signs post, and how many occupants are needed for an HOV 3 lane?
sec09-F58-card.expected_back: HOV signs specify the required number of occupants and applicable times; HOV three requires at least three people in the vehicle.

sec09-F59-card.front: In which direction does all traffic circulate around the central island of a roundabout?
sec09-F59-card.expected_back: A roundabout moves traffic counterclockwise around a central island.

sec09-R01-card.front: Which approach lane should you pick before a two-lane roundabout for a right turn, left turn, U-turn, or straight path?
sec09-R01-card.memory_hook: Right turns right, left turns left
sec09-R01-card.expected_back: For a roundabout, use the right approach lane for a right turn and the left for a left turn or U-turn; either approach lane may serve straight travel.

sec09-R02-card.front: Which side of the splitter island do you pass on, and to what speed should you slow when approaching a roundabout?
sec09-R02-card.expected_back: Approach a roundabout to the splitter island’s right and slow to ten to fifteen miles per hour

sec09-R03-card.front: How should you treat bicyclists as you approach a roundabout entrance?
sec09-R03-card.expected_back: At a roundabout entrance, watch for bicyclists and permit them to merge into the entry lane.

sec09-R04-card.front: Who has priority at the pedestrian crosswalk set back from a roundabout entrance?
sec09-R04-card.expected_back: Yield to pedestrians using the roundabout crosswalk.

sec09-R05-card.front: Who must yield when an approaching vehicle meets vehicles already circulating inside a roundabout?
sec09-R05-card.expected_back: Entering drivers must yield to vehicles already circulating in the roundabout.

sec09-R06-card.front: Once you are circulating inside a roundabout, when is stopping appropriate?
sec09-R06-card.expected_back: Within a roundabout, stop only to avoid a collision; circulating traffic has priority over entering traffic.

sec09-R07-card.front: May you overtake or pass another vehicle while traveling inside a roundabout?
sec09-R07-card.expected_back: Travel counterclockwise to the central island’s right, keep speed low and do not pass within the roundabout.

sec09-R08-card.front: Which vulnerable road users must you watch for and yield to as you exit a roundabout?
sec09-R08-card.expected_back: When exiting a roundabout, watch for and yield to both pedestrians and bicyclists.

sec09-R09-card.front: Why does a diverging diamond interchange temporarily shift traffic onto the left side of the road?
sec09-R09-card.expected_back: A diverging diamond interchange temporarily routes traffic on the road’s left side so left turns avoid crossing opposing traffic.

sec09-R10-card.front: Which maneuvers are permitted from a shared center turn lane, and by which directions of traffic?
sec09-R10-card.expected_back: A shared center lane serves left turns and permitted U-turns by traffic traveling in either direction.

sec09-R11-card.front: What arrow pattern and yellow boundary lines identify a shared center left-turn lane?
sec09-R11-card.expected_back: Shared-center-lane pavement arrows alternate directions, and its boundaries pair a solid yellow line with a broken yellow line.

sec09-R12-card.front: What rush-hour operational change can affect a shared center lane before you pull into it?
sec09-R12-card.expected_back: A shared center lane can become reversible during rush hours; confirm entry is permitted and safe.

sec09-R13-card.front: What are the only two exceptions that allow reversing inside an active travel lane?
sec09-R13-card.expected_back: Do not reverse in a travel lane except to parallel park or when necessary to leave a driveway.

sec09-R14-card.front: What should you do if you accidentally drive past your intended turn or highway exit?
sec09-R14-card.expected_back: After missing a turn or exit, continue to a safe turnaround instead of backing up.

sec09-R15-card.front: May you stop inside an active travel lane if you get lost, experience a breakdown, or let out a passenger?
sec09-R15-card.expected_back: Do not stop in a travel lane for confusion, a breakdown or a passenger; continue until you can safely pull off.

sec09-R16-card.front: Which lane should you normally travel in when a road has two or more lanes moving in the same direction?
sec09-R16-card.expected_back: On roads with at least two same-direction lanes, keep right except when passing.

sec09-R17-card.front: Which lane is recommended on a three-or-more-lane highway when heavy traffic is merging on and exiting off?
sec09-R17-card.expected_back: On roads with at least three same-direction lanes and heavy entering or exiting traffic, use the center travel lane.

sec09-R18-card.front: What is the intended purpose of the far-left lane on a multilane highway?
sec09-R18-card.expected_back: The far-left lane on a multilane road is intended for passing slower traffic.

sec09-R19-card.front: Does Delaware allow passing a left-turning vehicle on its right side?
sec09-R19-card.expected_back: Delaware permits passing a left-turning vehicle on the right, but this maneuver demands great caution.

sec09-R20-card.front: Unlike many states, what does Delaware allow regarding the paved shoulder when passing a left-turning vehicle on the right?
sec09-R20-card.expected_back: Delaware permits using the shoulder to pass a left-turning vehicle on the right, with extreme care because others may not expect it.

sec09-R21-card.front: When no signs or arrows direct otherwise, which lane must you start a turn from and finish in?
sec09-R21-card.expected_back: Without turn-control signs or markings, turn from the lane nearest the intended direction into the closest corresponding lane, crossing as few lanes as possible.

sec09-R22-card.front: If you need a different lane after turning at an intersection, when should you make that lane change?
sec09-R22-card.expected_back: Make a turn directly without straying across lane lines or obstructing traffic; change lanes afterward if needed.

sec09-R23-card.front: Which two steering errors must you avoid before and during a right turn?
sec09-R23-card.expected_back: Avoid swinging left before a right turn or wide into a distant lane while completing it.

sec09-R24-card.front: Why must you avoid cutting a left turn sharply across the corner of the cross street?
sec09-R24-card.expected_back: Do not cut a left-turn corner sharply into traffic approaching from the left; leave room for opposing left-turners.

sec09-R25-card.front: What lane-keeping rule applies when two or more side-by-side lanes are marked to turn together?
sec09-R25-card.expected_back: Where multiple lanes are designated for a turn, remain in your own lane throughout the turn.

sec09-R26-card.front: May everyday motorists turn around using a highway median opening posted for emergency vehicles only?
sec09-R26-card.expected_back: A median opening marked for emergency vehicles only may not be used by ordinary drivers.

sec09-R27-card.front: Which side of a legal median crossover opening must you stay on unless signs direct otherwise?
sec09-R27-card.expected_back: When a median crossing is legal and no sign says otherwise, stay to the right of its opening.

sec09-R28-card.front: Does having technical right-of-way ever excuse failing to avoid a preventable crash with a vehicle or pedestrian?
sec09-R28-card.expected_back: Whatever the right-of-way situation, do everything possible to avoid striking another vehicle or a pedestrian.

sec09-R29-card.front: What must drivers do whenever yielding is necessary to avoid striking pedestrians crossing the street?
sec09-R29-card.expected_back: Drivers must yield when needed to avoid hitting pedestrians crossing the road.

sec09-R30-card.front: Who holds right-of-way when your car crosses a sidewalk into or out of a lot, alley, or driveway?
sec09-R30-card.expected_back: When entering or leaving a driveway, alley or parking lot across a sidewalk, yield to pedestrians.

sec09-R31-card.front: When is a motor vehicle legally allowed on a sidewalk?
sec09-R31-card.expected_back: Driving along a sidewalk is illegal; crossing it is the permitted exception.

sec09-R32-card.front: What priority belongs to a pedestrian with a guide dog or white cane, and why must you never honk?
sec09-R32-card.expected_back: A pedestrian using a guide dog or white cane has absolute priority; do not sound the horn and risk confusion or fright.

sec09-R33-card.front: Who must yield when a driver turning left meets oncoming traffic continuing straight?
sec09-R33-card.expected_back: A left-turning driver must yield to opposing vehicles continuing straight.

sec09-R34-card.front: Who has right-of-way when entering a traffic circle or rotary?
sec09-R34-card.expected_back: Drivers entering a traffic circle or rotary must give way to those already inside.

sec09-R35-card.front: At an intersection with no signs or signals, who gets right-of-way and what extra precaution does the handbook advise?
sec09-R35-card.expected_back: At an intersection without a stop or yield sign or signal, yield to traffic from the right; the handbook also recommends considering all vehicles before entry.

sec09-R36-card.front: Who proceeds first at a four-way stop when vehicles arrive at slightly different times?
sec09-R36-card.expected_back: At a four-way stop, the first driver to arrive proceeds first after stopping completely.

sec09-R37-card.front: Which vehicle proceeds first when two drivers reach a four-way stop at the exact same moment?
sec09-R37-card.expected_back: If vehicles reach a four-way stop together, the one on the right proceeds first.

sec09-R38-card.front: Who must yield when a vehicle pulls onto a street from a driveway, alley, or roadside shoulder?
sec09-R38-card.expected_back: Entering a road from a driveway, alley or roadside requires yielding to traffic on the main road.

sec09-R39-card.front: What must drivers entering a roadway from a dedicated turn-only lane be prepared to do?
sec09-R39-card.expected_back: Vehicles entering from turn-only lanes must yield and stop when necessary.

sec09-R40-card.front: When must you stay behind the stop line even though the traffic signal ahead is green?
sec09-R40-card.expected_back: Do not enter an intersection unless you can clear it without stopping and blocking it.

sec09-R41-card.front: What duty falls on a driver overtaking another vehicle traveling in the same direction if the lead car slows or stops?
sec09-R41-card.expected_back: A driver overtaking a same-direction vehicle must yield to that vehicle even if it slows or stops.

sec09-R42-card.front: How must you yield to an emergency vehicle using an air horn, siren, flashing red or blue light, or loudspeaker?
sec09-R42-card.expected_back: Yield to an emergency vehicle using a siren, air horn or flashing red or blue light by moving as far right as possible, following any loudspeaker instructions.

sec09-R43-card.front: What should you do if you are already inside an intersection when an emergency vehicle approaches?
sec09-R43-card.expected_back: If already in an intersection when an emergency vehicle approaches, clear the intersection before pulling over.

sec09-R44-card.front: When is opposing traffic not required to stop for a loading school bus in Delaware, and how must those drivers proceed?
sec09-R44-card.expected_back: Stop before a school bus loading or unloading children from either direction, except opposing traffic on a highway with at least four lanes, which must still move slowly.

sec09-R45-card.front: How many seconds before flashing red lights do a school bus's overhead yellow lights activate?
sec09-R45-card.expected_back: A bus’s alternating overhead yellow lights activate about ten seconds before its flashing red lights; approach carefully and expect a stop.

sec09-R46-card.front: Which two clues confirm you may cautiously proceed after stopping for a school bus?
sec09-R46-card.expected_back: After a bus stops for pupils, wait until its red lights cease and its stop arm retracts before proceeding cautiously.

sec09-R47-card.front: Who is legally presumed responsible if a witness reports a car passing a stopped school bus and the driver cannot be identified?
sec09-R47-card.expected_back: If police, a bus operator or a crossing guard witnesses a school-bus-stop violation and cannot identify the driver, the registered owner is presumed to have committed it.

sec09-R48-card.front: What fine range applies to a first conviction for passing a stopped school bus with red lights and stop arm active?
sec09-R48-card.expected_back: For a first conviction of passing a bus stopped with overhead and stop-arm red lights flashing, the fine is one hundred fifteen dollars to two hundred thirty dollars.

sec09-R49-card.front: How much jail time can be imposed on a first conviction for illegally passing a stopped school bus?
sec09-R49-card.expected_back: The same first bus-passing offense may carry thirty to sixty days of imprisonment, alone or with the fine.

sec09-R50-card.front: What fine range applies to a repeat stopped-school-bus passing conviction within three years?
sec09-R50-card.expected_back: A similar bus-passing offense within three years carries a fine of one hundred fifteen dollars to five hundred seventy-five dollars.

sec09-R51-card.front: What imprisonment range applies to a subsequent stopped-school-bus passing offense within three years?
sec09-R51-card.expected_back: A later similar bus-passing offense within three years also carries imprisonment from sixty days to six months.

sec09-R52-card.front: How long is your license suspended upon a first conviction for passing a stopped school bus with flashing red lights?
sec09-R52-card.expected_back: A first conviction for passing a stopped bus with the described flashing red lights results in a one-month license or driving-privilege suspension.

sec09-R53-card.front: What suspension length applies to a second school-bus stop violation within three years?
sec09-R53-card.expected_back: For a second school-bus violation within three years of an earlier violation, the source table gives six months of suspension.

sec09-R54-card.front: How long does the conviction table suspend a driver for a third or later school-bus violation within three years?
sec09-R54-card.expected_back: The school-bus conviction table gives a one-year suspension for a third or later violation within three years of an earlier violation.

sec09-R55-card.front: After a second school-bus conviction, how long must you serve with zero driving authority before qualifying for a conditional license?
sec09-R55-card.expected_back: For a second school-bus offense, a conditional license may be issued only after at least three months without driving authority.

sec09-R56-card.front: After a third or later school-bus offense, how long must you go without any driving authority before a conditional license is possible?
sec09-R56-card.expected_back: For a third or later school-bus offense, a conditional license may be issued only after at least six months without driving authority.

sec09-R57-card.front: Can you obtain a conditional or hardship license during the one-month suspension for a first school-bus offense?
sec09-R57-card.expected_back: No driving authority is available during the first school-bus offense’s one-month suspension.
