sec03-R20-card.question_text: When does a first-time adult applicant pay, and how long do they have to pass all exams?
sec03-R20-card.teaching_text: Letting more than a year slip past application forces you to restart the exam process.

sec03-R21-card.question_text: Who must accompany an adult learner permit holder during driving practice?
sec03-R21-card.teaching_text: Adult learners need a supervisor at least twenty-one licensed for that vehicle class, unlike GDL's twenty-five rule.

sec03-R22-card.question_text: How long must a first-time adult applicant practice after passing the knowledge test before taking the road exam?
sec03-R22-card.teaching_text: Delaware builds in at least thirty days of practice between passing written rules and road testing.

sec04-F01-card.question_text: Which five everyday vehicle types does a Delaware Class D Operator's License cover?
sec04-F01-card.teaching_text: Standard noncommercial passenger vehicles and light delivery vans fall under Class D without commercial endorsements.

sec04-F02-card.question_text: What maximum gross vehicle weight rating applies to a Class D vehicle and its trailer?
sec04-F02-card.teaching_text: Crossing twenty-six thousand pounds in vehicle or trailer rating pushes operation into commercial licensing rules.

sec04-F03-card.question_text: What passenger capacity limit defines a Class D vehicle when counting the driver?
sec04-F03-card.teaching_text: Buses built to seat sixteen or more people counting the driver require a commercial passenger endorsement.

sec04-F04-card.question_text: May a Class D operator drive a vehicle placarded for hazardous materials?
sec04-F04-card.teaching_text: Any load requiring federal hazardous-materials placards demands a commercial license with a hazmat endorsement.

sec04-F05-card.question_text: Which vehicles are covered for practice under a Class D or Privilege Card learner permit?
sec04-F05-card.teaching_text: Holding a passenger-car permit never authorizes behind-the-wheel practice on a motorcycle or heavy rig.

sec04-F06-card.question_text: Who must ride along with a standard Class D or Driving Privilege Card learner-permit holder?
sec04-F06-card.teaching_text: Notice the wording older than twenty-one here, so check your supervisor's age and license before rolling.

sec04-F07-card.question_text: Which vehicles and program rules apply to a graduated learner permit?
sec04-F07-card.teaching_text: Graduated learners drive standard passenger vehicles while following strict teen supervision, passenger, and curfew caps.

sec04-F08-card.question_text: What two core abilities does the Delaware driver examination evaluate?
sec04-F08-card.teaching_text: Testing both traffic law recall and physical car control keeps unprepared drivers off public streets.

sec04-F09-card.question_text: How many parts make up the Delaware driver examination?
sec04-F09-card.teaching_text: Knowing all four stages up front keeps first-time applicants from overlooking vision or sign testing.

sec04-F10-card.question_text: What does DMV vision screening verify?
sec04-F10-card.teaching_text: Spotting hazards, brake lights, and street signs on time starts with meeting minimum eyesight standards.

sec04-F11-card.question_text: What restriction goes onto your license if you need glasses or contacts to pass vision screening?
sec04-F11-card.teaching_text: Driving without required glasses or contacts turns a corrective-lens code into an unlawful license violation.

sec04-F12-card.question_text: What is the general visual-acuity standard for an unrestricted Delaware license?
sec04-F12-card.teaching_text: Hitting twenty over forty either bare-eyed or with corrective lenses clears the standard eyesight bar.

sec04-F13-card.question_text: What time-of-day restriction may the DMV grant based on an applicant's eyesight?
sec04-F13-card.teaching_text: Limiting borderline acuity to daytime hours lets drivers run errands safely without night glare risks.

sec04-F14-card.question_text: Which visual-acuity range falls into Delaware's daylight-driving category?
sec04-F14-card.teaching_text: Eyesight worse than twenty over forty yet within twenty over fifty triggers daytime-only consideration.

sec04-F15-card.question_text: How can the highway-sign exam test sign recognition when words are removed?
sec04-F15-card.teaching_text: Snow, mud, or distance hides text first, so drivers must read octagons, pennants, and colors instantly.

sec04-F16-card.question_text: Which three roadway control categories must exam applicants explain?
sec04-F16-card.teaching_text: Safe navigation relies on reading overhead lights and painted lane stripes alongside roadside signposts.

sec04-F17-card.question_text: Which three topics supply Delaware's rules-of-the-road exam questions?
sec04-F17-card.teaching_text: Studying defensive driving habits matters just as much as memorizing right-of-way statutes and penalties.

sec04-F18-card.question_text: How many days after passing the knowledge test may a Class D applicant take the road exam?
sec04-F18-card.teaching_text: A mandatory thirty-day gap prevents rushing straight from the computer terminal into traffic testing unpracticed.

sec04-F19-card.question_text: What two ways does the handbook offer for scheduling a Class D road exam?
sec04-F19-card.teaching_text: Road tests require advance slots through the online scheduler or local office phone rather than walk-ins.

sec04-F20-card.question_text: Which personal driving document must a road-exam applicant bring to test check-in?
sec04-F20-card.teaching_text: Showing up with an expired or forgotten permit cancels your road-test slot at the counter.

sec04-F21-card.question_text: What age and credential must your accompanying driver have at a Class D road exam?
sec04-F21-card.teaching_text: Examiners verify your accompanying driver's valid license and twenty-one-plus age before starting.

sec04-F22-card.question_text: What registration proof is required for the road-exam vehicle and any attached trailer?
sec04-F22-card.teaching_text: Missing or expired registration cards cancel the road test before you ever leave the parking lot.

sec04-F23-card.question_text: Which two formats of valid vehicle insurance proof are accepted at the road exam?
sec04-F23-card.teaching_text: Delaware accepts digital insurer cards on your phone screen alongside traditional printed coverage cards.

sec04-F24-card.question_text: Roughly how many minutes of driving does the Delaware road exam take?
sec04-F24-card.teaching_text: Expecting a half-hour evaluation helps you stay focused and steady instead of rushing maneuvers.

sec04-F25-card.question_text: Will a Delaware road examiner ever instruct you to break traffic law or drive unsafely?
sec04-F25-card.teaching_text: Never run a stop sign or speed thinking an examiner is testing obedience through trickery.

sec04-F26-card.question_text: How must a road-exam applicant respond to signs, signals, and pavement markings?
sec04-F26-card.teaching_text: Rolling past stop lines or ignoring lane arrows costs automatic points during on-road scoring.

sec04-F27-card.question_text: Which turnaround maneuver must a Class D road-exam applicant perform?
sec04-F27-card.teaching_text: Smooth signaling, mirror scans, and curb control make or break the narrow-street turnaround grade.

sec04-F28-card.question_text: Which directional turns must be demonstrated during the road examination?
sec04-F28-card.teaching_text: Examiners grade turn-signal timing, proper lane entry, and smooth speed control in both directions.

sec04-F29-card.question_text: What multi-lane lateral maneuver must a road-exam applicant demonstrate?
sec04-F29-card.teaching_text: Skipping a mirror scan, blinker, or blind-spot head check loses points on every lane shift.

sec04-F30-card.question_text: What traffic-priority knowledge must an applicant apply live during the road exam?
sec04-F30-card.teaching_text: Hesitating endlessly or cutting off oncoming traffic shows shaky command of intersection priority.

sec04-F31-card.question_text: How is driving speed evaluated on the Delaware road examination?
sec04-F31-card.teaching_text: Both creeping far below traffic flow and exceeding posted limits hurt your road-exam score.

sec04-F32-card.question_text: How many feet of backing must a road-exam applicant demonstrate?
sec04-F32-card.teaching_text: Practicing straight fifty-foot reverse tracking while looking back prevents curb taps on test day.

sec04-R01-card.question_text: What traffic-entry skill must an applicant demonstrate on the road exam?
sec04-R01-card.teaching_text: Matching road speed and picking a safe gap keeps merging traffic flowing without sudden braking.

sec04-R02-card.question_text: Which two multi-vehicle spacing maneuvers are tested on the road exam?
sec04-R02-card.teaching_text: Tailgating ahead or cutting back too close after passing marks an immediate safety deduction.

sec04-R03-card.question_text: What crossroad maneuver must an applicant demonstrate during road testing?
sec04-R03-card.teaching_text: Scanning left-right-left and halting behind white stop lines demonstrates disciplined intersection entry during road testing.

sec04-R04-card.question_text: What pre-drive inspection and cabin knowledge must a road-exam applicant show?
sec04-R04-card.teaching_text: Fumbling for defrosters, hazard flashers, wipers, or headlights before rolling signals poor vehicle readiness.

sec04-R05-card.question_text: Who supplies the vehicle used for the Delaware road examination?
sec04-R05-card.teaching_text: DMV offices do not lend fleet cars, so applicants must bring their own compliant vehicle.

sec04-R06-card.question_text: Which license class must the road-exam vehicle belong to?
sec04-R06-card.teaching_text: You must demonstrate road skills inside a vehicle belonging to the exact class you seek.

sec04-R07-card.question_text: Which three requirements must the road-exam vehicle satisfy before testing?
sec04-R07-card.teaching_text: Burnt-out brake lights, bald tires, or missing paperwork end your road appointment at the curb.

sec04-R08-card.question_text: What check does the examiner run before the road test begins?
sec04-R08-card.teaching_text: Testing horn, lights, signals, and glass beforehand protects both you and the examiner in traffic.

sec04-R09-card.question_text: What rule governs smoking during the Delaware road examination?
sec04-R09-card.teaching_text: Keeping the cabin smoke-free and both hands dedicated to driving is mandatory throughout testing.

sec04-R10-card.question_text: Which two cabin distractions are prohibited throughout the road test?
sec04-R10-card.teaching_text: Silencing your phone and turning off the stereo ensures you hear every examiner instruction clearly.

sec04-R11-card.question_text: Who must accompany a test-taker who lacks solo Delaware driving authority?
sec04-R11-card.teaching_text: Driving yourself solo to the DMV on a supervised-only permit breaks the law before testing starts.

sec04-R12-card.question_text: Why must a licensed driver remain at the DMV test site while you take your road exam?
sec04-R12-card.teaching_text: If you do not pass, only a licensed driver waiting onsite can legally drive that car home.

sec04-R13-card.question_text: When should you ask the license examiner to clarify anything you do not understand?
sec04-R13-card.teaching_text: Clearing up maneuver instructions in the lot prevents confused hesitation out in live traffic.

sec04-R14-card.question_text: How long must an applicant hold off before retesting after failing any part of the road exam?
sec04-R14-card.teaching_text: Thirty practice days give you time to fix weak maneuvers instead of repeating the same errors.

sec04-R15-card.question_text: What study tool does the handbook point applicants toward for exam practice?
sec04-R15-card.teaching_text: Running through DMV sample questions builds confidence with multiple-choice phrasing before test day.

sec04-R16-card.question_text: What should drivers do if their health changes in a way that could affect safe driving?
sec04-R16-card.teaching_text: Early medical review helps match restrictions or treatment before a health episode causes a crash.

sec04-R17-card.question_text: What must new or renewing applicants disclose about medical conditions?
sec04-R17-card.teaching_text: Honest disclosure during licensing and renewal lets DMV verify conditions are safely controlled.

sec04-R18-card.question_text: What statement may the DMV require from a licensed practitioner regarding a driver's medical condition?
sec04-R18-card.teaching_text: Having a condition does not bar licensing once your clinician confirms sufficient control for driving.

sec04-R19-card.question_text: When may a medically monitored driver have to submit an updated report each year?
sec04-R19-card.teaching_text: Tying annual medical updates to the end of your birth month gives a clear calendar deadline.

sec04-R20-card.question_text: What happens if a driver fails to turn in a required favorable medical report?
sec04-R20-card.teaching_text: Ignoring a mandatory medical-report deadline triggers automatic license suspension until favorable paperwork arrives.

sec04-R21-card.question_text: What fee applies to reinstate a license suspended for a missing medical report once cleared?
sec04-R21-card.teaching_text: Letting your deadline lapse into suspension costs fifty dollars even after your doctor clears you.

sec04-R22-card.question_text: Which three groups can ask the DMV to re-examine a driver's ability to operate safely?
sec04-R22-card.teaching_text: Relatives, officers, and doctors who witness unsafe decline can trigger a formal safety review.

sec04-R23-card.question_text: Which numbered practitioner report must the DMV receive before licensing someone prone to loss of consciousness?
sec04-R23-card.teaching_text: Filing form M V three hundred forty-six documents sufficient medical control before driving privileges start.

sec04-R24-card.question_text: What does the handbook's August two thousand twenty-four note encourage licensed practitioners to report?
sec04-R24-card.teaching_text: Proactive clinician reporting helps intervene before severe cognitive or physical impairment causes highway tragedy.

sec04-R25-card.question_text: What option does a driver have when unable to obtain a favorable medical report?
sec04-R25-card.teaching_text: Turning in your card voluntarily avoids a formal suspension mark and saves reinstatement fees later.

sec04-R26-card.question_text: What reinstatement fee applies after a favorable medical report if you surrendered voluntarily before suspension?
sec04-R26-card.teaching_text: Surrendering proactively before suspension saves the fifty-dollar reinstatement charge once health recovers.

sec04-R27-card.question_text: What extra step applies if a medically surrendered license stays surrendered past one year?
sec04-R27-card.teaching_text: Stepping away from driving longer than twelve months triggers additional testing to verify sharp skills.

sec04-R28-card.question_text: How does suspension affect your driving privileges?
sec04-R28-card.teaching_text: Exam questions contrast temporary suspension removal against complete license cancellation under a formal revocation.

sec04-R29-card.question_text: How does revocation affect your driving privileges?
sec04-R29-card.teaching_text: Unlike a temporary suspension pause, a formal revocation terminates your existing driver license outright.

sec04-R30-card.question_text: What fee is required to reinstate a suspended Delaware license?
sec04-R30-card.teaching_text: Memorize fifty dollars for suspension reinstatement versus two hundred dollars after revocation.

sec04-R31-card.question_text: What fee is required to reinstate a revoked Delaware license?
sec04-R31-card.teaching_text: Full license revocation quadruples your reinstatement fee compared with paying fifty dollars after a suspension.

sec04-R32-card.question_text: Which three tests may be required before reinstating a withdrawn license?
sec04-R32-card.teaching_text: Paying the reinstatement fee alone may not restore privileges without passing all three DMV exams.

sec04-R33-card.question_text: How does Delaware respond when a resident commits a serious traffic conviction in another state?
sec04-R33-card.teaching_text: Picking up a major violation across state lines triggers the same loss of privileges back home.

sec04-R34-card.question_text: Are traffic convictions from other states placed onto your Delaware driving record?
sec04-R34-card.teaching_text: Interstate reporting posts out-of-state tickets directly onto your home Delaware driving history.

sec04-R35-card.question_text: By what annual deadline must a driver licensed under medical review submit a fresh report?
sec04-R35-card.teaching_text: Submitting your clinician's annual update before your birth month closes prevents automatic suspension.

sec04-R36-card.question_text: What reports and DMV tests are required to retain driving privileges during a requested re-examination?
sec04-R36-card.teaching_text: Keeping your card under re-examination demands doctor clearance plus passing vision, written, and road tests.

sec04-R37-card.question_text: What specialized assessment or training may also be required during a requested re-examination?
sec04-R37-card.teaching_text: Rehabilitation specialists evaluate adaptive controls and compensatory habits to see if safe driving remains possible.

sec05-F01-card.question_text: In Delaware, what mandatory license action follows driving impaired by liquor or narcotics?
sec05-F01-card.teaching_text: Unlike discretionary point actions, an alcohol or narcotic impairment offense triggers automatic loss of your privilege to drive.

sec05-F02-card.question_text: How does Delaware classify leaving a crash scene when another person is injured or killed?
sec05-F02-card.teaching_text: Fleeing an injury or fatal collision turns an emergency into an automatic license loss alongside severe criminal exposure.

sec05-F03-card.question_text: What license consequence follows trying to flee after an officer gives a visible or audible stop signal?
sec05-F03-card.teaching_text: Ignoring sirens or flashing patrol lights endangers everyone on the road and costs your license automatically.

sec05-F04-card.question_text: How many reckless-driving convictions within twelve consecutive months trigger mandatory license revocation in Delaware?
sec05-F04-card.teaching_text: Stacking multiple reckless citations inside a single rolling year proves a dangerous pattern that revokes driving privileges.

sec05-F05-card.question_text: What license action applies if operating a vehicle causes or contributes to another person's death?
sec05-F05-card.teaching_text: Even contributing to a fatal crash behind the wheel carries automatic revocation rather than ordinary demerit points.

sec05-F06-card.question_text: Where does an assault crime involving death through vehicle operation fall in Delaware's license-withdrawal rules?
sec05-F06-card.teaching_text: Test questions group fatal vehicular assault directly with mandatory revocation offenses rather than temporary administrative suspensions.

sec05-F07-card.question_text: What happens to your Delaware license if you use a motor vehicle to commit a serious crime?
sec05-F07-card.teaching_text: Turning a car into an instrument for a serious crime forfeits your legal privilege to operate on public roads.

sec05-F08-card.question_text: What license sanction applies to making false statements or submitting fraudulent information in Delaware?
sec05-F08-card.teaching_text: Lying on official licensing paperwork is treated as fraud that triggers mandatory revocation even without a traffic stop.

sec05-F09-card.question_text: What mandatory license consequence applies to possessing or consuming alcohol while under age twenty-one?
sec05-F09-card.teaching_text: Many teens miss that underage drinking or possession revokes a Delaware license even away from a car.

sec05-F10-card.question_text: What happens if someone posts bond after arrest for a mandatory revocation offense and fails to appear in court?
sec05-F10-card.teaching_text: Forfeiting bond by missing court never dodges the DMV penalty because revocation applies exactly as if convicted.

sec05-F11-card.question_text: For how long may a driver declared a habitual offender have their Delaware license revoked?
sec05-F11-card.teaching_text: Habitual-offender status carries one of Delaware's longest administrative withdrawals, keeping repeat violators off the road for years.

sec05-F12-card.question_text: Can someone convicted as a habitual offender obtain a Delaware work or hardship license?
sec05-F12-card.teaching_text: Exam questions test this strict bar because habitual offenders lose all restricted work-driving options during revocation.

sec05-F13-card.question_text: How many listed habitual-offender offenses within what time window can trigger a habitual-offender finding?
sec05-F13-card.teaching_text: Accumulating three major violations inside five years moves a driver out of ordinary point rules into multi-year revocation.

sec05-F14-card.question_text: Which six major driving violations open Delaware's habitual-offender offense list alongside crash and fraud violations?
sec05-F14-card.teaching_text: Driving unlicensed or while already suspended sits right beside impaired and reckless driving on the habitual-offender roster.

sec05-F15-card.question_text: Which four crash, statement, restricted-license, and police-command violations also appear on the habitual-offender list?
sec05-F15-card.teaching_text: Breaking occupational-license terms or ignoring an officer's stop command counts toward the three-strike habitual-offender total.

sec05-F16-card.question_text: How many combined major and lesser convictions such as speeding within how many years can establish habitual-offender status?
sec05-F16-card.teaching_text: Even routine speeding tickets stack toward habitual-offender status when total convictions hit ten within three years.

sec05-F17-card.question_text: What action will the DMV take when it has reason to believe a Delaware resident committed a suspension-triggering offense?
sec05-F17-card.teaching_text: Administrative suspension protects road safety promptly without waiting months for every court appeal to conclude.

sec05-F18-card.question_text: What crash outcomes let the DMV suspend a resident's license when reckless or unlawful driving contributed?
sec05-F18-card.teaching_text: Contributing unlawfully to a serious wreck triggers license suspension even before long-term civil claims are settled.

sec05-F19-card.question_text: When will the DMV suspend a resident's license over health concerns?
sec05-F19-card.teaching_text: Safe driving requires physical and mental capability, so conditions preventing competent vehicle control suspend highway privileges.

sec05-F20-card.question_text: Besides a serious vehicle-law violation, which unauthorized-use and payment issues appear on Delaware's suspension list?
sec05-F20-card.teaching_text: Even a bounced payment to the DMV or taking a car without permission can suspend your driving privilege.

sec05-F21-card.question_text: Which wheel-spinning, property-damage, and out-of-state court violations can suspend your Delaware license?
sec05-F21-card.teaching_text: Ignoring a traffic summons in another state follows you home and suspends your Delaware license through interstate reporting.

sec05-F22-card.question_text: Which four acts involving borrowed, fake, withdrawn, or falsified licenses are grounds for suspension?
sec05-F22-card.teaching_text: Letting a friend borrow your card or keeping a withdrawn license triggers an administrative suspension of your own.

sec05-F23-card.question_text: Which insurance violations, school-bus offense, and card-tampering acts appear among Delaware suspension grounds?
sec05-F23-card.teaching_text: Passing a stopped school bus or driving without valid insurance proof puts your license directly on the suspension list.

sec05-F24-card.question_text: Which family-obligation failure and post-cancellation tag mistake appear on Delaware's license-suspension list?
sec05-F24-card.teaching_text: Canceling car insurance without turning in the license plate first can suspend your personal driver license.

sec05-F25-card.question_text: What minimum dollar debt and days overdue under a child-support order can trigger license suspension?
sec05-F25-card.teaching_text: Exam questions pair both thresholds together, requiring at least one thousand dollars owed and thirty days delinquency.

sec05-F26-card.question_text: What two steps are required to lift and reinstate a license after a child-support suspension?
sec05-F26-card.teaching_text: Paying arrears alone does not restore driving privileges until the DMV receives official agency release and your fee.

sec05-F27-card.question_text: How does Delaware's Problem Driver Program respond to accumulating convictions or points?
sec05-F27-card.teaching_text: The program intervenes early with education and escalating penalties before repeat violations lead to serious crashes.

sec05-F28-card.question_text: What three corrective steps may Delaware's Problem Driver Program impose?
sec05-F28-card.teaching_text: Sanctions step up from a warning letter to required behavior coursework and mandatory time off the road.

sec05-F29-card.question_text: What DMV fee is required to reinstate your license after a Problem Driver Program suspension?
sec05-F29-card.teaching_text: Serving out suspension months never automatically reactivates your card until the required fifty-dollar DMV fee is paid.

sec05-F30-card.question_text: How many points are assessed for speeding one through nine miles per hour over the posted limit?
sec05-F30-card.teaching_text: Even single-digit speeding adds two demerit points unless a qualifying first-time mail-in or online option applies.

sec05-F31-card.question_text: How many points apply in Delaware for speeding ten through fourteen miles per hour above the limit?
sec05-F31-card.teaching_text: Crossing ten miles per hour over the limit doubles the point hit from two points straight to four.

sec05-F32-card.question_text: What point total and extra exposure apply when speeding at least twenty miles per hour over the limit?
sec05-F32-card.teaching_text: Driving twenty or more over brings five points and opens the door to extra administrative action including suspension.

sec05-F33-card.question_text: How many points and what extra sanction risk apply for passing a stopped school bus?
sec05-F33-card.teaching_text: Passing loading children hits the top six-point bracket and can trigger immediate license suspension beyond points.

sec05-F34-card.question_text: How many points does a reckless-driving conviction add in Delaware's point table?
sec05-F34-card.teaching_text: A single six-point reckless conviction puts you three-quarters of the way to an eight-point DMV warning letter.

sec05-F35-card.question_text: What point value and further consequence apply to operating a vehicle in a manner that causes death?
sec05-F35-card.teaching_text: Fatal vehicle operation carries the maximum six-point assessment alongside separate suspension or revocation exposure.

sec05-F36-card.question_text: How many administrative points are assigned to an aggressive-driving conviction in Delaware?
sec05-F36-card.teaching_text: Aggressive driving matches reckless driving and stopped-bus violations at six points on a single conviction.

sec05-F37-card.question_text: How many points are assessed for disregarding a stop sign or a red traffic light?
sec05-F37-card.teaching_text: Rolling a stop sign or running a red light puts three points on your record plus intersection crash risk.

sec05-F38-card.question_text: How many points apply to other moving violations covered under the cited Delaware traffic-law chapters?
sec05-F38-card.teaching_text: Even unlisted lane, turn, or following infractions chip away at your record at two points apiece.

sec05-F39-card.question_text: At what calculated point total within two years may the DMV begin noncommercial point action?
sec05-F39-card.teaching_text: The DMV tracks a rolling twenty-four-month window and steps in once calculated points reach eight.

sec05-F40-card.question_text: How are violation points weighted across months one through twenty-four for administrative action, and who is excluded?
sec05-F40-card.teaching_text: Noncommercial points drop to half weight in year two for DMV action, though commercial license holders never get that break.

sec05-F41-card.question_text: Does a requested Delaware driving record show internally halved points or full-value points?
sec05-F41-card.teaching_text: Employers and insurers reviewing your official record see full point values even after year-two DMV halving.

sec05-R01-card.question_text: What specific step does the DMV take when a driver reaches eight calculated points?
sec05-R01-card.teaching_text: That warning letter signals that one more four-point ticket will trigger mandatory coursework or suspension.

sec05-R02-card.question_text: What must a driver complete within how many days upon reaching twelve calculated points?
sec05-R02-card.teaching_text: Missing the ninety-day completion window without an approved DMV extension converts coursework directly into a license suspension.

sec05-R03-card.question_text: What mandatory suspension applies at the twelve-point mark if a driver skips the course or prefers suspension?
sec05-R03-card.teaching_text: Failing to finish the required class or choosing time off the road instead locks in a two-month suspension.

sec05-R04-card.question_text: How long is the mandatory license suspension at fourteen calculated points in Delaware?
sec05-R04-card.teaching_text: Notice how every two extra calculated points above twelve adds two more months of mandatory suspension.

sec05-R05-card.question_text: How long is the mandatory suspension when calculated points hit sixteen?
sec05-R05-card.teaching_text: Sixteen calculated points sidelines you for half a year before you can qualify for reinstatement.

sec05-R06-card.question_text: What mandatory suspension length applies at eighteen calculated points?
sec05-R06-card.teaching_text: The point-action ladder stays predictable here, pairing eighteen calculated points with an eight-month mandatory suspension.

sec05-R07-card.question_text: How many months of mandatory suspension apply when calculated points reach twenty?
sec05-R07-card.teaching_text: Twenty calculated points triggers a mandatory ten-month suspension plus behavior-course verification before reinstatement.

sec05-R08-card.question_text: What course requirement applies to reinstate after a fourteen-, sixteen-, eighteen-, or twenty-point suspension?
sec05-R08-card.teaching_text: Waiting out the suspension months alone is not enough without recent completion of the behavior or attitudinal course.

sec05-R09-card.question_text: What mandatory suspension period does Delaware assign at twenty-two calculated points?
sec05-R09-card.teaching_text: Hitting twenty-two calculated points tops the point table with a full one-year mandatory license suspension.

sec05-R10-card.question_text: Within what lookback window must a behavior or attitudinal course be completed to reinstate after twenty-two points?
sec05-R10-card.teaching_text: Just like the fourteen-through-twenty brackets, getting your license back after twenty-two points requires recent course completion.

sec05-R11-card.question_text: Under what conditions does a Class D driver avoid points on a first one-to-fourteen-mph speeding ticket in three years?
sec05-R11-card.teaching_text: Contesting in a different forum can forfeit this break because payment must go through VAC, Alderman's mail-in, or online.

sec05-R12-card.question_text: What administrative step follows a conviction for going twenty to twenty-four over the speed limit?
sec05-R12-card.teaching_text: Even on an otherwise clean record, one conviction twenty-to-twenty-four over triggers a DMV advisory letter.

sec05-R13-card.question_text: How is suspension length calculated starting at twenty-five miles per hour above the posted speed limit?
sec05-R13-card.teaching_text: Every extra five miles per hour above twenty-five tacks another full month onto the initial one-month suspension.

sec05-R14-card.question_text: Which high-speed conviction bracket lets a driver choose the behavior or attitudinal course instead of suspension?
sec05-R14-card.teaching_text: That course-in-lieu option vanishes the moment your convicted speed hits thirty miles per hour over the limit.

sec05-R15-card.question_text: What happens to suspension and reinstatement once speeding reaches thirty miles per hour or more above the limit?
sec05-R15-card.teaching_text: At thirty over, coursework can no longer replace suspension and instead becomes mandatory for reinstatement.

sec05-R16-card.question_text: What penalty applies for driving at least fifty over the limit or hitting one hundred miles per hour on a highway?
sec05-R16-card.teaching_text: Triple-digit highway speed or fifty over locks in a full-year suspension on a single ticket.

sec05-R17-card.question_text: When may the DMV grant an occupational license during a Problem Driver Program suspension?
sec05-R17-card.teaching_text: A separate Title twenty-one suspension or revocation blocks an occupational permit even when extreme work hardship exists.

sec05-R18-card.question_text: Which two prior-record conditions disqualify a driver from receiving an occupational license?
sec05-R18-card.teaching_text: Having two policy suspensions in three years or an occupational permit in the past year bars relief.

sec05-R19-card.question_text: During which part of a suspension will the DMV never issue an occupational license?
sec05-R19-card.teaching_text: Every suspended driver must sit out at least the opening month before any occupational driving privilege starts.

sec05-R20-card.question_text: What happens to occupational-license eligibility when calculated points reach fifteen or more within twenty-four months?
sec05-R20-card.teaching_text: High point totals block hardship driving until time or aging drops your calculated total under fifteen.

sec05-R21-card.question_text: What two penalties apply if you are convicted of violating occupational-license restrictions?
sec05-R21-card.teaching_text: Driving outside approved work hours or routes forfeits your hardship card and doubles down on suspension time.

sec05-R22-card.question_text: How much extra withdrawal time is added for driving during a suspension or revocation?
sec05-R22-card.teaching_text: Getting caught behind the wheel while suspended tacks on matching withdrawal time up to twelve extra months.

sec05-R23-card.question_text: Is any driving authority permitted during the remaining withdrawal or extension after driving suspended, and what must happen to prior authority?
sec05-R23-card.teaching_text: Once extended for driving while withdrawn, every limited permit is canceled and must be turned in immediately.

sec05-R24-card.question_text: How many listed offenses during one continuous episode establish aggressive driving in Delaware?
sec05-R24-card.teaching_text: Combining behaviors like speeding, tailgating, and unsafe lane weaving in one incident elevates separate tickets into aggressive driving.

sec05-R25-card.question_text: What fine range applies to a first aggressive-driving offense in Delaware?
sec05-R25-card.teaching_text: That court fine hits alongside six administrative points and mandatory behavior-modification coursework.

sec05-R26-card.question_text: Within how many days must someone convicted of aggressive driving finish the behavior or attitudinal course?
sec05-R26-card.teaching_text: The ninety-day clock is strict, so delaying enrollment after conviction risks an automatic follow-on suspension.

sec05-R27-card.question_text: What happens if a driver fails to attend the required course after an aggressive-driving conviction?
sec05-R27-card.teaching_text: Ignoring court-mandated behavior training turns a conviction you could drive through into an active license suspension.

sec05-R28-card.question_text: How long is Delaware's approved behavior-modification course, and where in the state is it offered?
sec05-R28-card.teaching_text: Plan for at least a full eight-hour session available locally across New Castle, Kent, and Sussex counties.

sec05-R29-card.question_text: How much does the behavior-modification course cost, and who receives that payment?
sec05-R29-card.teaching_text: Test questions check both the one-hundred-dollar amount and that you pay the course provider rather than the DMV.

sec05-R30-card.question_text: How quickly does the course provider transmit electronic completion notice to the DMV?
sec05-R30-card.teaching_text: Finishing right on the final deadline day can cut it close if forty-eight-hour electronic reporting is needed.

sec05-R31-card.question_text: How many points of administrative credit may the DMV grant for completing an approved defensive-driving course?
sec05-R31-card.teaching_text: A three-point buffer helps cushion administrative thresholds when the DMV calculates internal penalty totals.

sec05-R32-card.question_text: Does defensive-driving credit erase existing DMV points or lower totals seen for employment or insurance review?
sec05-R32-card.teaching_text: This classic DMV exam trap catches drivers who assume a defensive class wipes past tickets off employer records.

sec05-R33-card.question_text: For how many years does an approved defensive-driving course remain valid after completion?
sec05-R33-card.teaching_text: Refreshing your approved defensive-driving certificate every three years preserves both safety habits and administrative credit.

sec05-R34-card.question_text: How does consuming even a small amount of alcohol affect crash risk compared with drinking none?
sec05-R34-card.teaching_text: Impairment starts well below statutory DUI limits, making zero alcohol the safest standard before taking the wheel.

sec07-F01-card.question_text: What registration status is required for vehicles operated on Delaware highways?
sec07-F01-card.teaching_text: Operating an unregistered car on public Delaware roads invites immediate enforcement stops and registration penalties.

sec07-F02-card.question_text: How many days do new Delaware residents have after moving in to title and register their vehicles?
sec07-F02-card.teaching_text: Keep this distinct from address updates because new arrivals get sixty days to complete titling and registration.

sec07-F03-card.question_text: How many headlights of what color, beam type, and placement does a Delaware-registered automobile need?
sec07-F03-card.teaching_text: Both left and right white multibeam lamps let oncoming drivers gauge your vehicle's width at night.

sec07-F04-card.question_text: At least how many feet ahead must high beams illuminate people and vehicles?
sec07-F04-card.teaching_text: Weak or misaimed high beams leave too little sight distance to brake for unlit hazards at highway speed.

sec07-F05-card.question_text: How far ahead must low beams illuminate people, and where must their light avoid shining?
sec07-F05-card.teaching_text: Proper low-beam aim lights pedestrians one hundred feet ahead without blinding oncoming traffic.

sec07-F06-card.question_text: What lighting rule applies whenever windshield wipers are running due to bad weather?
sec07-F06-card.teaching_text: Daytime running lamps leave your taillights dark in rain, so turn full headlights on with wipers.

sec07-F07-card.question_text: How many original-design rear taillights of what color and visibility distance are required?
sec07-F07-card.teaching_text: Red taillights visible five hundred feet back give trailing drivers early warning on dark roadways.

sec07-F08-card.question_text: What color options and visibility distance apply to the required front parking light?
sec07-F08-card.teaching_text: White or amber front parking illumination marks a stationary vehicle clearly from five hundred feet away.

sec07-F09-card.question_text: What color and visibility distance apply to the rear parking light, and can a taillight fulfill it?
sec07-F09-card.teaching_text: Standard factory wiring often uses a red taillight filament to satisfy rear five-hundred-foot parking visibility.

sec07-F10-card.question_text: What color must the registration-plate light be, and from how far must the tag number be readable?
sec07-F10-card.teaching_text: Burned-out or colored tag bulbs are an easy nighttime equipment stop when plates cannot be read at fifty feet.

sec07-F11-card.question_text: Where must a registration-plate light never cast its beam?
sec07-F11-card.teaching_text: Exposed white bulbs shining backward confuse following drivers who expect white lamps only on oncoming or reversing cars.

sec07-F12-card.question_text: Which colors are permitted for an original-design rear stop light in Delaware?
sec07-F12-card.teaching_text: Blue, clear, or smoked aftermarket brake lenses fail Delaware's amber-to-red original-design rule.

sec07-F13-card.question_text: What activates a stop light, and how far away must it be visible in normal sunlight?
sec07-F13-card.teaching_text: Dim or tinted brake lamps that vanish in bright sun invite high-speed rear-end collisions.

sec07-F14-card.question_text: If a vehicle is equipped with two stop lights, does just one working lamp satisfy Delaware law?
sec07-F14-card.teaching_text: A single burned-out brake bulb fails state inspection and can be mistaken for a single-sided turn signal.

sec07-F15-card.question_text: What front and rear turn-signal setup is required on vehicles manufactured after nineteen fifty-three?
sec07-F15-card.teaching_text: Every modern vehicle needs working directional lamps at all four corners rather than relying on hand signals.

sec07-F16-card.question_text: What color range is legal for front turn signals in Delaware?
sec07-F16-card.teaching_text: Front turn indicators stay in the white-to-amber spectrum so drivers never confuse them with rear brake lamps.

sec07-F17-card.question_text: What color range is legal for rear turn signals in Delaware?
sec07-F17-card.teaching_text: White bulbs in broken rear signal housings violate the amber-through-red rule and blind drivers behind you.

sec07-F18-card.question_text: At what minimum distance must front and rear turn signals be visible in normal sunlight?
sec07-F18-card.teaching_text: Matching brake-light visibility at one hundred feet ensures sunlit intersection traffic spots your intended turn.

sec07-F19-card.question_text: What rule applies if a vehicle built in nineteen fifty-three or earlier has turn signals installed?
sec07-F19-card.teaching_text: Even on pre-mandate classics, any turn signals mounted on the vehicle must operate properly.

sec07-F20-card.question_text: What rear reflector equipment is required on passenger vehicles built after nineteen fifty-three?
sec07-F20-card.teaching_text: Passive red reflectors keep a parked car visible in oncoming headlights even if its battery dies.

sec07-F21-card.question_text: How many reflectors and what color layout are required on vehicles built after nineteen seventy-seven?
sec07-F21-card.teaching_text: Amber front-side and red rear-side reflectors tell cross-traffic which way an unlit car faces.

sec07-F22-card.question_text: What minimum surface area and visibility distance must vehicle reflectors meet?
sec07-F22-card.teaching_text: Tiny novelty reflectors fail Delaware law because each unit needs four square inches visible at five hundred feet.

sec07-F23-card.question_text: Must vehicle reflectors be separate pieces, or can they be built into lamp lenses?
sec07-F23-card.teaching_text: Cracking a factory taillight lens often breaks both the lamp housing and its built-in legal reflector.

sec07-F24-card.question_text: What side-marker lamps are required on passenger vehicles manufactured since nineteen seventy-two?
sec07-F24-card.teaching_text: Illuminated amber front-side and red rear-side markers outline your car's profile at dark intersections.

sec07-F25-card.question_text: What luminous lens area and visibility distance must side-marker lamps provide?
sec07-F25-card.teaching_text: Side-marker lamps share the exact four-square-inch and five-hundred-foot standard used for reflectors.

sec07-F26-card.question_text: How must vehicle brakes apply across the sides of the car, and what standards must they meet?
sec07-F26-card.teaching_text: Uneven side-to-side braking yanks a car sideways into adjacent lanes during hard emergency stops.

sec07-F27-card.question_text: Within how many feet must the parking or emergency brake stop a vehicle from twenty miles per hour?
sec07-F27-card.teaching_text: State test writers love quizzing this exact twenty-mile-per-hour stopping benchmark for emergency parking brakes.

sec07-F28-card.question_text: Which vehicle windows must be made of automotive safety glass?
sec07-F28-card.teaching_text: Ordinary household glass shatters into jagged shards in a crash, so every auto window requires safety glass.

sec07-F29-card.question_text: Which stickers or signs are permitted on vehicle windows in Delaware?
sec07-F29-card.teaching_text: Unapproved decals cluttering glass create dangerous blind spots that hide pedestrians and cyclists.

sec07-F30-card.question_text: What must windshield wipers be capable of clearing from the glass?
sec07-F30-card.teaching_text: Streaking or torn wiper blades turn oncoming headlights into blinding smears during wet night drives.

sec07-F31-card.question_text: What view must a vehicle's rear-view mirror provide to the driver?
sec07-F31-card.teaching_text: Monitoring trailing traffic behind your bumper helps you prevent sudden-braking and lane-change collisions.

sec07-F32-card.question_text: What mirror equipment is required whenever cargo or design obstructs the interior mirror's view?
sec07-F32-card.teaching_text: Packing a trunk ceiling-high without both left and right exterior mirrors leaves a massive rear blind zone.

sec07-F33-card.question_text: What muffler equipment and operating state does every Delaware motor vehicle require?
sec07-F33-card.teaching_text: A working exhaust muffler dampens engine roar continuously and channels toxic gases safely away from the cabin.

sec07-F34-card.question_text: What noise benchmark applies to vehicles, and how does Delaware treat excessive or loud noise?
sec07-F34-card.teaching_text: Modified loud exhausts breach federal noise limits and drown out emergency sirens around you.

sec07-F35-card.question_text: From at least how many feet away must a vehicle's horn be audible under normal conditions?
sec07-F35-card.teaching_text: A weak horn that cannot carry two hundred feet fails to alert drifting highway drivers in time.

sec07-F36-card.question_text: Which passenger cars require safety belts for every front-seat occupant?
sec07-F36-card.teaching_text: January one, nineteen sixty-eight marks the federal front-seat belt cutoff for passenger automobiles.

sec07-F37-card.question_text: From what manufacture cutoff do trucks, buses, and multipassenger vehicles require belts for every front-seat occupant?
sec07-F37-card.teaching_text: Notice the three-and-a-half-year gap between passenger cars in sixty-eight and trucks or buses in July seventy-one.

sec07-F38-card.question_text: How many spotlights may a vehicle carry, and where must their intense beams never point?
sec07-F38-card.teaching_text: Aiming a spotlight left or past one hundred feet ahead blinds oncoming drivers instantly.

sec07-F39-card.question_text: How many front fog lamps of what colors and mounting height may a vehicle carry?
sec07-F39-card.teaching_text: Low twelve-to-thirty-inch mounting cuts underneath fog banks instead of reflecting glare back off droplets.

sec07-F40-card.question_text: How much must a fog-lamp beam drop over its first twenty-five feet?
sec07-F40-card.teaching_text: That downward four-inch angle keeps fog beams hugging the pavement rather than glaring upward.

sec07-F41-card.question_text: What color range is permitted for rear backing lamps?
sec07-F41-card.teaching_text: White-to-amber reverse lamps illuminate behind the bumper while alerting pedestrians that a car is backing.

sec07-F42-card.question_text: Which vehicles may display colored lamps beyond standard factory lights, markers, and turn signals?
sec07-F42-card.teaching_text: Decorative blue, green, or red underglow and grille lights confuse motorists watching for real emergency responders.

sec07-F43-card.question_text: At most how many front lamps rated three hundred candlepower or higher may shine at the same time?
sec07-F43-card.teaching_text: Running auxiliary lights alongside four active high-output bulbs exceeds the four-lamp glare cap.

sec07-F44-card.question_text: Between what minimum and maximum heights above the ground must a headlamp's center sit?
sec07-F44-card.teaching_text: Extreme suspension lifts or drops push headlamps outside the twenty-four-to-fifty-four-inch zone and blind oncoming cars.

sec07-F45-card.question_text: May an ordinary motor vehicle display a red light visible from the front?
sec07-F45-card.teaching_text: Red visible from ahead signals an approaching emergency responder or the rear of a vehicle, never ordinary oncoming traffic.

sec07-F46-card.question_text: Which three vehicle types are listed among exceptions to Delaware's general ban on flashing lights?
sec07-F46-card.teaching_text: Special public-safety, student-loading, and winter-plow operations rely on distinctive strobes to warn approaching drivers.

sec07-F47-card.question_text: What special revolving or flashing light color may snow-removal equipment display?
sec07-F47-card.teaching_text: Spotting green flashing beacons in winter storms alerts you immediately to slow-moving plow blades ahead.

sec07-F48-card.question_text: Which two flashing-light functions are legal on ordinary passenger vehicles?
sec07-F48-card.teaching_text: Outside directional turns and four-way hazard warnings, aftermarket strobe kits remain illegal on everyday cars.

sec07-F49-card.question_text: Are unauthorized frames, symbols, or accessories allowed on a Delaware license plate?
sec07-F49-card.teaching_text: Decorative frames or emblems that obscure state names or registration stickers trigger equipment citations and inspection failures.

sec07-F50-card.question_text: When is installing a lamp or reflector prohibited on a vehicle?
sec07-F50-card.teaching_text: Swapping in noncompliant bulbs or housings scatters beam patterns engineered for safe visibility.

sec07-F51-card.question_text: During what exact date span are studded tires permitted in Delaware?
sec07-F51-card.teaching_text: Both October fifteen and April fifteen are included so drivers can mount and remove winter studs around frost season.

sec07-F52-card.question_text: During what Delaware dates are studded tires banned, and what rule applies out of state?
sec07-F52-card.teaching_text: Metal studs chew up warm bare pavement, and crossing state lines requires obeying each visited state's tire calendar.

sec07-F53-card.question_text: Is using a muffler cut-out legal on Delaware roads?
sec07-F53-card.teaching_text: Exhaust bypass valves dump unmuffled noise and fumes straight underneath the vehicle in violation of state law.

sec07-F54-card.question_text: Which three loud audible devices are prohibited on ordinary motor vehicles?
sec07-F54-card.teaching_text: Sirens and whistles are reserved so drivers immediately recognize genuine emergency responders.

sec07-F55-card.question_text: How many vehicles may a motor vehicle generally tow, and what exception applies to a tractor with a semitrailer?
sec07-F55-card.teaching_text: Daisy-chaining multiple trailers behind an ordinary passenger vehicle creates dangerous highway whip instability.

sec07-F56-card.question_text: What is the maximum legal length of the connection between a towing vehicle and a towed vehicle?
sec07-F56-card.teaching_text: A tow line longer than fifteen feet lets another driver mistakenly try to merge between the two connected cars.

sec07-F57-card.question_text: What marker must be attached when towing with a chain, cable, or rope?
sec07-F57-card.teaching_text: Thin tow cables practically vanish against asphalt unless a foot-square red cloth alerts cross-traffic and pedestrians.

sec07-F58-card.question_text: Which portion of the front windshield is covered by Delaware's tint restriction?
sec07-F58-card.teaching_text: Keeping tint above the upper five-inch or AS-one line preserves clear forward sightlines day and night.

sec07-F59-card.question_text: Which two exterior vehicle items must never be covered with tint material?
sec07-F59-card.teaching_text: Smoked covers over headlamps, brake lights, or tags slash visibility and block law-enforcement plate reads.

sec07-F60-card.question_text: What mirror equipment must a vehicle have if it is fitted with window tint?
sec07-F60-card.teaching_text: Darkened rear glass cuts cabin mirror clarity at night, making dual side mirrors mandatory.

sec07-F61-card.question_text: What document is required to have aftermarket tint on the windows immediately beside the driver?
sec07-F61-card.teaching_text: Without a valid medical tint waiver carried inside the car, front-side aftermarket film fails inspection and stops.

sec07-F62-card.question_text: Between which daily light milestones must headlights be used while driving?
sec07-F62-card.teaching_text: Relying on streetlamps at dusk leaves your vehicle nearly invisible until full headlights come on at sunset.

sec07-F63-card.question_text: At what visibility cutoff must you turn on your headlights even during daytime?
sec07-F63-card.teaching_text: Fog, smoke, or heavy overcast cutting sightlines to a thousand feet or less demands full headlights.

sec07-F64-card.question_text: What does Delaware's headlight-use subsection require whenever your windshield wipers are running?
sec07-F64-card.teaching_text: Linking headlights directly to wiper operation guarantees both front beams and rear taillights shine in storms.

sec07-F65-card.question_text: How many feet before meeting an oncoming vehicle must you switch to low beams?
sec07-F65-card.teaching_text: Dropping high beams at five hundred feet prevents blinding oncoming traffic right before cars pass.

sec07-F66-card.question_text: Within what following distance behind another vehicle must you use low beams?
sec07-F66-card.teaching_text: High beams within two hundred feet bounce straight off the lead car's mirrors into that driver's eyes.

sec07-F67-card.question_text: What restraint requirement applies to every occupant in a vehicle?
sec07-F67-card.teaching_text: Delaware's restraint rule covers front and back seats alike using either a proper belt or child seat.

sec07-F68-card.question_text: Can a police officer pull a vehicle over solely for seeing an unbuckled occupant?
sec07-F68-card.teaching_text: Delaware enforces primary seat-belt stops, meaning no other traffic violation is needed to pull you over.

sec07-F69-card.question_text: Who receives the citation when passengers are unbuckled or improperly restrained?
sec07-F69-card.teaching_text: Before shifting out of park, verify every rider's belt because unrestrained passengers go on the driver's ticket.

sec07-R01-card.question_text: What kind of insurance policy establishes financial responsibility for titling and registering a vehicle in Delaware?
sec07-R01-card.teaching_text: Out-of-state policies from carriers unlicensed in Delaware will not clear DMV titling or registration counters.

sec07-R02-card.question_text: What is Delaware's minimum personal-injury protection coverage for one person hurt in a crash?
sec07-R02-card.teaching_text: Personal-injury protection covers immediate medical bills and lost wages starting at fifteen thousand dollars per individual.

sec07-R03-card.question_text: What is Delaware's minimum personal-injury protection total for all people injured in a single crash?
sec07-R03-card.teaching_text: Keep PIP's fifteen-and-thirty-thousand split separate from bodily-injury liability's twenty-five-and-fifty-thousand split on test day.

sec07-R04-card.question_text: What is the minimum liability coverage for bodily injury or death of one person in a crash?
sec07-R04-card.teaching_text: Twenty-five thousand dollars is the statutory floor protecting you when one person suffers injury or death.

sec07-R05-card.question_text: What minimum bodily-injury or death liability coverage applies when two or more people are hurt in one crash?
sec07-R05-card.teaching_text: Multi-victim crashes hit the fifty-thousand-dollar bodily-injury minimum ceiling fast, leaving drivers personally liable above policy limits.

sec07-R06-card.question_text: What minimum coverage amount protects against damaging someone else's property in a crash?
sec07-R06-card.teaching_text: Together with twenty-five and fifty thousand for injuries, ten thousand completes Delaware's 25/50/10 liability minimum.

sec07-R07-card.question_text: In what formats is an original Delaware insurance identification card accepted?
sec07-R07-card.teaching_text: Displaying an official insurer app or digital ID card works just like keeping a printed copy.

sec07-R08-card.question_text: Where must the insurance card stay, and which three pieces of policy info must it show?
sec07-R08-card.teaching_text: Missing the insurer's NAIC code or showing an expired date range invalidates your in-car proof.

sec07-R09-card.question_text: How often are Delaware insurance identification cards reissued?
sec07-R09-card.teaching_text: Swap old glovebox cards every six months so you never hand an officer an expired card during a stop.

sec07-R10-card.question_text: Can a valid insurance policy itself serve as acceptable proof of coverage?
sec07-R10-card.teaching_text: Presenting the active insurance policy document satisfies coverage proof when an ID card isn't handy.

sec07-R11-card.question_text: For how long and in what format is a written insurance binder acceptable?
sec07-R11-card.teaching_text: Newly purchased policies often start with a letterhead binder that expires as proof after thirty days.

sec07-R12-card.question_text: When does the DMV accept faxed proof of insurance, and what fax source is rejected?
sec07-R12-card.teaching_text: Faxing your own card from a store or office gets rejected because only direct insurer-to-DMV faxes count.

sec07-R13-card.question_text: What check applies when you present electronic proof of insurance?
sec07-R13-card.teaching_text: Screenshots of canceled policies get caught fast because electronic insurance proof is subject to live verification.

sec07-R14-card.question_text: What fine range applies for driving an uninsured vehicle in Delaware?
sec07-R14-card.teaching_text: Getting cited once without coverage costs far more than keeping an active policy all year.

sec07-R15-card.question_text: What fine range applies to a subsequent uninsured-driving offense within three years?
sec07-R15-card.teaching_text: Getting caught uninsured again within three years doubles both ends of the fine range.

sec07-R16-card.question_text: What additional penalties apply for presenting false insurance proof?
sec07-R16-card.teaching_text: Forging an insurance card stacks an extra five-hundred-dollar fine and up to thirty jail days onto uninsured penalties.

sec07-R17-card.question_text: Who may remove a vehicle's license plate after proper owner notice when affirmative insurance proof is missing?
sec07-R17-card.teaching_text: Ignoring lapse notices can leave your parked vehicle legally stripped of its tag until coverage is proven.

sec07-R18-card.question_text: What must a vehicle owner do with a valid license plate before canceling insurance?
sec07-R18-card.teaching_text: Canceling coverage on a parked or broken car while keeping the tag triggers automatic daily uninsured penalties.

sec07-R19-card.question_text: How does the DMV check whether active Delaware registrations maintain insurance?
sec07-R19-card.teaching_text: You do not need to be pulled over to get caught uninsured because active registrations face random audits.

sec07-R20-card.question_text: How is the uninsured audit penalty calculated across the first thirty days and each day afterward?
sec07-R20-card.teaching_text: That five-dollar daily charge keeps ticking after day thirty until coverage starts, the tag returns, or registration expires.

sec07-R21-card.question_text: What happens if a vehicle owner fails to respond to a DMV insurance-audit request?
sec07-R21-card.teaching_text: Even fully insured owners lose valid registration if they toss a DMV insurance-audit letter unopened.

sec07-R22-card.question_text: How much does it cost per registration to reinstate after an insurance-audit suspension?
sec07-R22-card.teaching_text: Clearing an audit suspension requires paying fifty dollars per affected tag on top of any uninsured-day fines.

sec07-R23-card.question_text: Where does vehicle inspection fit in the order of Delaware's title and registration process?
sec07-R23-card.teaching_text: Secure Delaware insurance first, clear the inspection lane second, and complete title-and-registration application third.

sec07-R24-card.question_text: Which vehicle ownership or registration document must you bring to inspection?
sec07-R24-card.teaching_text: Inspectors verify the VIN against your title certificate or current registration card before running lane tests.

sec07-R25-card.question_text: How much are Delaware residents charged for state vehicle inspection?
sec07-R25-card.teaching_text: State-run DMV lanes perform safety and emissions inspections free of charge for Delaware residents.

sec07-R26-card.question_text: What three conditions must vehicle lamps meet during Delaware inspection?
sec07-R26-card.teaching_text: Clouded lenses or crooked headlight aim can fail the lane even when every bulb lights up.

sec07-R27-card.question_text: Which stopping check is performed on every vehicle brought through Delaware inspection?
sec07-R27-card.teaching_text: Inspection rollers measure live stopping force and side-to-side brake balance on every car in the lane.

sec07-R28-card.question_text: What two conditions must mirrors satisfy to pass inspection?
sec07-R28-card.teaching_text: Cracked mirror glass or caked grime distorts rear traffic distances and fails safety inspection.

sec07-R29-card.question_text: What operating and blade conditions must windshield wipers meet for inspection?
sec07-R29-card.teaching_text: Dry-rotted or split wiper rubber fails the lane quickly and costs only minutes to replace beforehand.

sec07-R30-card.question_text: How securely must hood and trunk latches hold their panels for inspection?
sec07-R30-card.teaching_text: A weak hood latch that pops open at highway speed instantly blinds the driver and shatters glass.

sec07-R31-card.question_text: Which four surface defects disqualify tires during a Delaware safety inspection?
sec07-R31-card.teaching_text: Sidewall bulges or showing tire cords warn of an imminent high-speed blowout and fail inspection immediately.

sec07-R32-card.question_text: What minimum tread depth across how many neighboring grooves is required at inspection?
sec07-R32-card.teaching_text: Worn tread shallower than two thirty-seconds of an inch in neighboring grooves hydroplanes easily on wet pavement.

sec07-R33-card.question_text: What door hardware is required to pass Delaware vehicle inspection?
sec07-R33-card.teaching_text: Rescuers and occupants need working door latches or an equivalent release to exit rapidly after a crash.

sec07-R34-card.question_text: How does Delaware inspection treat damaged or displaced body parts that stick out dangerously?
sec07-R34-card.teaching_text: Jagged fenders or loose trim jutting outward pose severe laceration hazards to pedestrians and cyclists.

sec07-R35-card.question_text: Must the vehicle's horn operate properly to pass state inspection?
sec07-R35-card.teaching_text: Inspectors tap the horn pad in the lane because an inoperative warning horn fails safety inspection.

sec07-R36-card.question_text: What two muffler and exhaust-system conditions are required at Delaware inspection?
sec07-R36-card.teaching_text: Exhaust leaks underneath the floorboard let odorless carbon monoxide seep directly into the passenger cabin.

sec07-R37-card.question_text: When must a vehicle have a catalytic converter installed for inspection?
sec07-R37-card.teaching_text: Deleting a factory catalytic converter spikes tailpipe pollutants and triggers an automatic inspection rejection.

sec07-R38-card.question_text: Which three visible fluid leaks will fail a vehicle at Delaware inspection?
sec07-R38-card.teaching_text: Dripping fuel, oil, or antifreeze creates fire and slick-pavement hazards that fail inspection on sight.

sec07-R39-card.question_text: What seat-belt rule applies while driving through the inspection lane itself?
sec07-R39-card.teaching_text: Technicians check both belt hardware and active belt use right as you pull into the inspection bay.

sec07-R40-card.question_text: How high above the ground may the bottom of a passenger-car bumper sit?
sec07-R40-card.teaching_text: Bumpers raised past twenty-two inches override other cars' crash zones during front or rear impacts.

sec07-R41-card.question_text: What is the maximum legal gap allowed between a vehicle's body and frame rail?
sec07-R41-card.teaching_text: Oversized body-lift spacers wider than three inches destabilize handling and fail Delaware inspection.

sec07-R42-card.question_text: How tall may a hood-mounted air scoop be under Delaware inspection rules?
sec07-R42-card.teaching_text: Tall hood scoops taller than three inches block forward road sightlines right in front of the bumper.

sec07-R43-card.question_text: Which model-year span is tested specifically for tailpipe exhaust emissions?
sec07-R43-card.teaching_text: Pre-OBD-II vehicles built from nineteen sixty-eight through nineteen ninety-five undergo tailpipe exhaust testing instead of computer scans.

sec07-R44-card.question_text: Which gasoline vehicles receive an OBD-II diagnostic test at inspection?
sec07-R44-card.teaching_text: An illuminated check-engine light on a ninety-six-or-newer light gas vehicle flags OBD-II fault codes during inspection.

sec07-R45-card.question_text: Which heavier gas or diesel model years and GVWR range also receive OBD-II testing?
sec07-R45-card.teaching_text: Medium-duty gas and diesel rigs from two thousand eight onward join OBD-II scanning up to fourteen thousand pounds.

sec07-R46-card.question_text: How long must a windshield crack be to trigger mandatory inspection failure?
sec07-R46-card.teaching_text: Any windshield crack exceeding five inches compromises glass strength and guarantees an inspection rejection.

sec07-R47-card.question_text: What size star chip on a windshield causes mandatory inspection failure?
sec07-R47-card.teaching_text: Keep five-inch cracks and one-inch star chips distinct because examiners love swapping those two glass numbers.

sec07-R48-card.question_text: What is the minimum vertical visibility height required for a windshield?
sec07-R48-card.teaching_text: Chopped roofs or heavy obstructions leaving less than ten vertical inches of clear windshield fail inspection.

sec07-R49-card.question_text: Which newer model years skip regular inspection, and what check still applies if never titled in Delaware?
sec07-R49-card.teaching_text: Bringing a newer out-of-state car into Delaware skips full lane testing yet still requires VIN verification.

sec07-R50-card.question_text: What inspection-free renewal option applies specifically to vehicles that are seven years old?
sec07-R50-card.teaching_text: At year seven, owners get one final single-year renewal before full lane inspections begin afterward.

sec07-R51-card.question_text: What late fee applies when you renew vehicle registration after it has expired?
sec07-R51-card.teaching_text: Renewing even one day past expiration adds a twenty-dollar late fee plus exposure to expired-tag stops.

sec07-R52-card.question_text: What three steps must happen after an unsafe or improperly equipped vehicle is rejected at inspection?
sec07-R52-card.teaching_text: The DMV withholds title, registration, and license plates until every rejected defect passes reinspection.

sec07-R53-card.question_text: When may an owner nearing registration expiration get a twenty-dollar temporary tag after failing inspection?
sec07-R53-card.teaching_text: Emissions-only failures can qualify for a temporary tag to finish repairs, whereas safety failures never do.

sec07-R54-card.question_text: After securing insurance and passing inspection, what is the third step in registering a vehicle?
sec07-R54-card.teaching_text: Submitting the title-and-registration packet completes the three-step sequence so your tag and card can issue.

sec07-R55-card.question_text: What must be done with an existing title certificate from a title-issuing state when applying in Delaware?
sec07-R55-card.teaching_text: Turning in the old state's paper title prevents duplicate active titles from circulating on the same vehicle.

sec07-R56-card.question_text: Which DMV form is used to request an out-of-state title held by a lender?
sec07-R56-card.teaching_text: When an auto lender holds your paper title, form MV-thirty-five prompts the lienholder to forward it.

sec07-R57-card.question_text: Which title-application and inspection form does the lane technician issue once safety and emissions pass?
sec07-R57-card.teaching_text: Keep MV-thirty-five and MV-two-twelve straight because MV-two-twelve is your passed lane report and title application.

sec07-R58-card.question_text: Which signatures satisfy a Delaware title and registration application?
sec07-R58-card.teaching_text: Leaving one co-owner's signature off without an original power of attorney stalls your paperwork at the window.

sec07-R59-card.question_text: What document-fee percentage, valuation basis, and minimum dollar floor normally apply when titling an out-of-state vehicle?
sec07-R59-card.teaching_text: Delaware calculates that document percentage off NADA trade-in book value while enforcing an eight-dollar floor.

sec07-R60-card.question_text: What proof exempts an incoming vehicle from Delaware's document fee?
sec07-R60-card.teaching_text: Receipts older than ninety days will not waive Delaware's document fee on an incoming vehicle.

sec07-R61-card.question_text: What document-fee percentage applies specifically to mobile homes in Delaware?
sec07-R61-card.teaching_text: Mobile homes carry a lower three-point-seven-five-percent document fee than passenger vehicles' five-point-two-five percent.

sec07-R62-card.question_text: Must liability-insurance proof be presented when titling or registering a vehicle?
sec07-R62-card.teaching_text: Without active Delaware liability proof in hand, the DMV cannot issue either your title or registration.

sec07-R63-card.question_text: How much is Delaware's vehicle title fee when there is no lien?
sec07-R63-card.teaching_text: Buying a vehicle outright avoids the extra twenty-dollar lien-recording charge, keeping your title fee at thirty-five dollars.

sec07-R64-card.question_text: How much is Delaware's vehicle title fee when a lender's lien is recorded?
sec07-R64-card.teaching_text: Financing a car raises the Delaware title fee from thirty-five dollars to fifty-five dollars.

sec07-R65-card.question_text: Who receives the paper title when a lien exists, and what must the customer provide?
sec07-R65-card.teaching_text: Your lender holds the physical title until payoff, so bring the lienholder's exact mailing address to the DMV.

sec07-R66-card.question_text: How much does one year of Delaware passenger-vehicle registration cost?
sec07-R66-card.teaching_text: Delaware's base passenger registration runs a flat forty dollars per year before any alternative-fuel add-ons.

sec07-R67-card.question_text: How much does a two-year Delaware passenger-vehicle registration cost?
sec07-R67-card.teaching_text: Two-year passenger registration simply doubles the forty-dollar annual rate to eighty dollars.

sec07-R68-card.question_text: What determines how many registration years—from one to seven—a vehicle in its first seven model years can get?
sec07-R68-card.teaching_text: Newer vehicles can match registration length to remaining inspection-exempt model years up to seven years.

sec07-R69-card.question_text: How much does a six-month Delaware registration cost?
sec07-R69-card.teaching_text: Notice six-month registration is twenty-one dollars rather than an exact twenty-dollar half of the annual rate.

sec07-R70-card.question_text: On what date do Delaware's extra annual registration fees for alternative-fuel vehicles take effect?
sec07-R70-card.teaching_text: Alternative-fuel road-use surcharges apply beginning October one, two thousand twenty-five alongside regular registration fees.

sec07-R71-card.question_text: How much is the extra yearly registration surcharge on a pure EV rated six thousand pounds or under?
sec07-R71-card.teaching_text: Most everyday battery-electric passenger cars fall in this light weight class and owe the base EV surcharge.

sec07-R72-card.question_text: How much is the extra yearly registration surcharge on a pure EV over six thousand up to ten thousand pounds?
sec07-R72-card.teaching_text: Heavier electric SUVs and pickups over six thousand up to ten thousand pounds step up to one hundred fifty dollars.

sec07-R73-card.question_text: How much is the extra yearly registration surcharge on a pure EV over ten thousand up to twenty-six thousand pounds?
sec07-R73-card.teaching_text: Medium-duty electric box trucks up to twenty-six thousand pounds pay two hundred sixty dollars annually.

sec07-R74-card.question_text: How much is the extra yearly registration surcharge on a pure EV rated over twenty-six thousand pounds?
sec07-R74-card.teaching_text: Heavy commercial-weight battery-electric rigs above twenty-six thousand pounds hit the top nine-hundred-dollar surcharge.

sec07-R75-card.question_text: How much is the extra yearly registration surcharge on a plug-in EV rated six thousand pounds or under?
sec07-R75-card.teaching_text: Plug-in electric models at or under six thousand pounds pay eighty-five dollars, twenty-five less than pure EVs.

sec07-R76-card.question_text: What extra annual registration fee applies to a plug-in electric vehicle above six thousand through ten thousand pounds?
sec07-R76-card.teaching_text: Keep pure EV at one hundred fifty distinct from plug-in electric at one hundred fifteen in the six-to-ten-thousand bracket.

sec07-R77-card.question_text: What extra annual registration fee applies to a plug-in electric vehicle above ten thousand through twenty-six thousand pounds?
sec07-R77-card.teaching_text: In the ten-to-twenty-six-thousand weight class, plug-in electric vehicles carry an even two-hundred-dollar annual add-on.

sec07-R78-card.question_text: What extra annual registration fee applies to a plug-in electric vehicle above twenty-six thousand pounds?
sec07-R78-card.teaching_text: Above twenty-six thousand pounds, plug-in electric vehicles pay six hundred dollars compared with nine hundred for pure EVs.

sec07-R79-card.question_text: How much is the extra yearly registration surcharge on a non-plug-in hybrid rated six thousand pounds or under?
sec07-R79-card.teaching_text: Standard non-plug-in hybrids still buy pump gas, so their light-vehicle surcharge starts lower at sixty dollars.

sec07-R80-card.question_text: What extra annual registration fee applies to a non-plug-in hybrid above six thousand through ten thousand pounds?
sec07-R80-card.teaching_text: Non-plug-in hybrid trucks and SUVs between six and ten thousand pounds add eighty dollars per year.

sec07-R81-card.question_text: What extra annual registration fee applies to a non-plug-in hybrid above ten thousand through twenty-six thousand pounds?
sec07-R81-card.teaching_text: Medium-duty non-plug-in hybrids in the ten-to-twenty-six-thousand tier pay one hundred forty dollars yearly.

sec07-R82-card.question_text: What extra annual registration fee applies to a non-plug-in hybrid vehicle above twenty-six thousand pounds?
sec07-R82-card.teaching_text: Heavy non-plug-in hybrids over twenty-six thousand pounds top the hybrid column at four hundred eighty dollars.

sec07-R83-card.question_text: What extra annual registration fee applies to a hydrogen, natural-gas, or other-fuel vehicle of six thousand pounds or less?
sec07-R83-card.teaching_text: Every weight tier for hydrogen and natural-gas vehicles matches the pure electric surcharge column dollar-for-dollar.

sec07-R84-card.question_text: What extra annual registration fee applies to an other-fuel vehicle above six thousand through ten thousand pounds?
sec07-R84-card.teaching_text: Just like pure electric vehicles, six-to-ten-thousand-pound hydrogen or natural-gas rigs pay one hundred fifty dollars.

sec07-R85-card.question_text: What extra annual registration fee applies to an other-fuel vehicle above ten thousand through twenty-six thousand pounds?
sec07-R85-card.teaching_text: Ten-to-twenty-six-thousand-pound hydrogen and natural-gas trucks mirror the pure-EV rate at two hundred sixty dollars.

sec07-R86-card.question_text: What extra annual registration fee applies to an other-fuel vehicle above twenty-six thousand pounds?
sec07-R86-card.teaching_text: Above twenty-six thousand pounds, hydrogen and natural-gas vehicles hit the same nine-hundred-dollar fee as pure EVs.

sec07-R87-card.question_text: What three items does the DMV issue once paperwork clears and document, title, and registration fees are paid?
sec07-R87-card.teaching_text: You walk out with the registration card and tag, while any active lienholder receives the paper title.

sec07-R88-card.question_text: Who must sign consent when someone under age eighteen applies for a Delaware vehicle title?
sec07-R88-card.teaching_text: Minors under eighteen cannot title a car solo without signed parent, guardian, or documented custodian consent.

sec07-R89-card.question_text: What two proofs must be presented before renewing a Delaware vehicle registration?
sec07-R89-card.teaching_text: Both active liability coverage and required safety-and-emissions passes must clear before a renewal sticker prints.

sec07-R90-card.question_text: How early before expiration may you inspect a vehicle, and does renewing early shorten your registration term?
sec07-R90-card.teaching_text: Inspecting up to ninety days ahead beats end-of-month lane lines without losing a single day of registration.

sec07-R91-card.question_text: Which group is exempted from Delaware's twenty-dollar late registration renewal fee?
sec07-R91-card.teaching_text: Deployment and duty-station orders protect active-duty service members from the standard late-renewal surcharge.

sec07-R92-card.question_text: Up to what weight do trailers skip a new inspection before registration renewal?
sec07-R92-card.teaching_text: Small utility and boat trailers at or under four thousand pounds renew without returning to the inspection lane.

sec07-R93-card.question_text: How far ahead and by what three channels are mail-renewal-eligible owners notified before expiration?
